PATS integrates (1) improved complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (ICEEMDAN) to separate low-frequency geometric trends from mid-to-high-frequency impacts, (2) physics-informed descriptors, namely sensitive intrinsic mode function (IMF) energy priors and statistics-based cumulative characteristic function (SCCF) features, injected into a lightweight Time-Series Mixer (TSMixer) backbone via feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), and (3) a multi-group ordinal head based on consistent rank logits (CORAL) to output reliability-aware probabilities. Experiments show 97.41% accuracy with 0.0187 expected calibration error (ECE) on K at 1.050 ms/sample, 96.30% accuracy with 0.0350 ECE on A at 0.964 ms/sample, and 100.00% accuracy with 0.0011 ECE on L. The artificial intelligence contribution lies in an interpretable physics-guided prior injection mechanism for nonstationary multivariate time-series grading, coupled with a reliability-oriented ordinal output design. The engineering application contribution is a deployable onboard monitoring framework for early-grade identification of high-speed railway subgrade differential settlement from onboard accelerations, enabling threshold-based alarming and risk grading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种物理感知时序混合器（PATS），用于从车厢加速度信号中早期识别高速铁路路基差异沉降的幅度、波长和横向系数，实现了97%以上的准确率和良好的校准误差。
AI.research_question: 如何利用车厢加速度信号实现高速铁路路基差异沉降的早期等级识别，同时保证物理一致性和置信度校准？
AI.motivation: 路基差异沉降会加剧轮轨相互作用和车辆-轨道振动，威胁行车安全与运营稳定性。早期识别困难在于微弱响应变化和非平稳加速度信号，传统数据驱动模型缺乏物理一致的指标和良好校准的置信度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理感知先验注入机制（FiLM）、改进的完全集合经验模态分解（ICEEMDAN）、时序混合器（TSMixer）、一致秩逻辑斯蒂（CORAL）多组序数分类。
AI.method: (1) ICEEMDAN分离低频几何趋势与中高频冲击成分；(2) 提取敏感本征模态函数能量先验和统计累积特征函数（SCCF）特征，通过FiLM注入TSMixer骨干网络；(3) 基于CORAL的多组序数头输出概率。
AI.findings: 横向系数K准确率97.41%，ECE 0.0187，速度1.050 ms/sample；幅度A准确率96.30%，ECE 0.0350，速度0.964 ms/sample；波长L准确率100.00%，ECE 0.0011。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出可解释的物理引导先验注入机制，用于非平稳多变量时序分级；结合面向可靠性的序数输出设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种可部署的车载监测框架，利用车厢加速度实现高速铁路路基差异沉降的早期等级识别，支持基于阈值的报警和风险分级。

title: An Economic Theory of “Two Fears” in Corporate Governance: Shareholder Heterogeneity and Market Pressures
affiliations: Kansas State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: An Economic Theory of “Two Fears” in Corporate Governance: Shareholder Heterogeneity and Market Pressures
detail.abstract: This paper presents a game-theoretic analysis of the internal and external pressures that shape a firm's operational objectives, which we refer to as the “two fears” in corporate governance. The first fear arises internally from diverse shareholder interests, while the second fear comes externally from competition with profit-maximizing rivals. In contrast to the outcomes associated with profit maximization in a standard Cournot oligopoly, our analysis through a two-stage game shows that a firm’s operational objectives—focused on maximizing firm profits and consumer utility—result in a profit-shifting effect. This strategy, aimed at maximizing a combined profit-cum-utility objective function, results in a win-win equilibrium for all diverse shareholders. In this scenario, a firm’s profits increase while competitors’ profits decrease. However, the profit-shifting effect and the win-win equilibrium do not manifest in a monopoly. All shareholders must agree that profit maximization is the monopoly's primary objective. This finding aligns with the traditional doctrine of profit maximization. In the context of oligopolistic competition, we demonstrate that the two fears in corporate governance highlight the importance of integrating shareholder heterogeneity with market pressures when establishing a firm's operational objectives. This study has significant implications for the relationship between shareholders and stakeholders (such as consumers).

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论分析，探讨了公司治理中"两种恐惧"——内部股东利益分歧和外部竞争对手压力——如何塑造企业的运营目标。研究表明，在寡头竞争下，企业采用利润与消费者效用最大化相结合的运营目标会产生"利润转移效应"，实现股东间的共赢均衡；但在垄断情境下，利润最大化仍是唯一目标。
AI.research_question: 企业内外部压力（股东利益分歧与市场竞争压力）如何影响企业的运营目标设定？不同类型的市场结构下，企业是否应追求超越利润最大化的目标？
AI.motivation: 传统公司治理理论强调利润最大化，但现实中企业面临来自多元化股东的内部压力以及来自竞争对手的外部压力。本文试图用博弈论框架统一分析这两种压力对企业运营目标的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（两阶段博弈）；古诺寡头垄断理论；公司治理中的股东异质性理论；利润转移效应；共赢均衡
AI.method: 两阶段博弈模型：第一阶段股东确定企业的运营目标（利润与消费者效用的加权组合），第二阶段企业在产品市场进行古诺竞争。
AI.findings: 1) 寡头竞争下，采用利润-消费者效用混合目标能产生利润转移效应，使本企业利润增加、竞争对手利润减少；2) 该策略可实现多元化股东的共赢均衡；3) 垄断情境下，利润转移效应和共赢均衡不成立，利润最大化仍是唯一最优目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将股东异质性与市场竞争压力纳入同一博弈框架，拓展了公司治理理论中对"企业目标"的理解；证明了在寡头市场中，偏离利润最大化反而能为股东创造更大价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会制定运营目标提供战略启示：在竞争性市场中，兼顾消费者利益的目标设定可以成为竞争优势；为股东关系管理提供理论依据，说明不同利益诉求的股东如何在非利润最大化目标下实现共赢。

title: A multi-label supervised contrastive loss with continuous positiveness
affiliations: Sabanci University, Sabanci University, University of Lincoln and Maastricht University

detail.title: A multi-label supervised contrastive loss with continuous positiveness
detail.abstract: Multi-Label scene classification constitutes a fundamental task in remote sensing, as it addresses real-world complexity by enabling a sample to have multiple land-cover categories. In this context, supervised contrastive learning is one of the prominent frameworks of multi-label multi-class classification. However, existing variants impose a discrete positiveness among samples (i.e.~a sample is either positive or not w.r.t~the anchor). We propose a new supervised multi-label contrastive loss that addresses this limitation via a continuous positiveness representation. The proposed method learns more discriminative representations than the standard binary paradigm by weighing contrastive forces based on label similarity. Experiments conducted across three optical remote sensing datasets indicate that the proposed strategy outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods with a significant margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于连续正性表示的监督多标签对比损失函数，用于遥感多标签场景分类，通过在标签相似度上加权对比力，学习更具判别性的特征表示，在三个光学遥感数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何改进监督对比学习中的离散正性假设，使其更适用于遥感多标签场景分类任务？
AI.motivation: 现有的监督对比学习变体在定义正负样本时采用二元离散范式（即一个样本要么是正样本要么不是），无法捕捉多标签场景中样本之间不同程度的标签相似性，限制了学习到的特征表示的质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监督对比学习、连续正性表示、基于标签相似度的对比力加权
AI.method: 提出一种新的监督多标签对比损失函数，用连续的标签相似度替代离散的正/负二元划分，根据样本间的标签重叠程度动态调整对比学习中的拉力与推力权重。
AI.findings: 在三个光学遥感数据集上，所提出的方法以显著优势超越了现有的最先进方法，验证了连续正性表示相比二元离散范式的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将监督对比学习中的正性概念从离散二元扩展到连续表示，为多标签场景下的对比学习提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为遥感多标签场景分类任务提供了一种高效且显著提升性能的损失函数，可直接应用于实际遥感图像解译系统中。

title: Multi-spectral solar active region detection via cross-attention fusion in yolov10
affiliations: Kim Il Sung University, Kim Il Sung University, Kim Il Sung University, Kim Il Sung University and Kim Il Sung University

detail.title: Multi-spectral solar active region detection via cross-attention fusion in yolov10
detail.abstract: Monitoring solar active regions (ARs) is essential for space weather forecasting, satellite operations, and astronaut safety. While deep learning has advanced AR detection, existing methods typically rely on single-wavelength images, missing complementary information across the electromagnetic spectrum. This paper presents MS-YOLOv10, a novel multi-spectral object detection framework that fuses Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI) continuum images with Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA) 211 Å and 335 Å channels. Unlike prior fusion approaches using simple concatenation or attention modules, we introduce a Cross-Attention Fusion Module (CAFM) that dynamically aligns and integrates features from different wavelengths before the backbone, plus a Multi-Scale Feature Refinement (MSFR) block in the neck. Trained on a newly constructed dataset of 15,000 aligned triple-band images (2010–2024), our method achieves mAP@0.5=0.96 and mAP@0.5:0.95=0.61, outperforming single-wavelength baselines by 4–7% and prior fusion methods (CatFuse, CBAMC, TransEnc) by 2–12%. Statistical analysis via Friedman test (p<0.001) and Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests confirms significance. Ablation studies reveal that cross-attention fusion at the backbone input is critical, and that temporal context further improves performance. Our code and dataset are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MS-YOLOv10多光谱目标检测框架，通过交叉注意力融合模块（CAFM）和多尺度特征精炼块（MSFR）融合HMI连续谱与AIA 211Å、335Å三个波段图像，在太阳活动区检测任务上显著超越单波长基线方法和现有融合方法。
AI.research_question: 如何有效融合多波段太阳图像（HMI连续谱、AIA 211Å、AIA 335Å）以提升太阳活动区检测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 现有太阳活动区检测方法通常仅使用单波长图像，忽略了电磁波谱中不同波段的互补信息；而现有融合方法（如简单拼接或注意力模块）无法有效动态对齐和整合多光谱特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 多光谱图像融合理论；2. 交叉注意力机制（Cross-Attention）；3. 多尺度特征精炼（Multi-Scale Feature Refinement）；4. YOLOv10目标检测框架。
AI.method: 1. 构建2010-2024年15,000张对齐的三波段图像数据集；2. 提出MS-YOLOv10框架，包含：Cross-Attention Fusion Module（CAFM）在骨干网络前动态对齐融合多波段特征；Multi-Scale Feature Refinement（MSFR）模块在颈部进行多尺度精炼；3. 使用Friedman检验和Holm校正Wilcoxon检验进行统计显著性验证。
AI.findings: 1. MS-YOLOv10达到mAP@0.5=0.96、mAP@0.5:0.95=0.61；2. 比单波长基线提升4-7%，比现有融合方法（CatFuse、CBAMC、TransEnc）提升2-12%；3. Friedman检验p<0.001，统计显著；4. 消融实验表明骨干网络输入处的交叉注意力融合最为关键，时间上下文信息可进一步提升性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将交叉注意力融合机制引入太阳活动区多光谱检测领域，提出CAFM实现动态特征对齐；2. 设计MSFR模块实现多尺度特征精炼，丰富了多光谱目标检测的方法论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 公开了2010-2024年对齐的三波段太阳图像数据集，为后续研究提供基准；2. 开源代码和模型，可直接用于空间天气预报、卫星运行和宇航员安全防护等实际场景。

title: CurioTrojan: A Curiosity-driven Spatiotemporal Backdoor Attack against Competitive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Wuhan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

detail.title: CurioTrojan: A Curiosity-driven Spatiotemporal Backdoor Attack against Competitive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
detail.abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) integrates the perceptual capabilities of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) with the decision-making abilities of Reinforcement Learning (RL), enabling broad applications. However, recent studies reveal that DRL inevitably faces the threat of backdoor attacks. Such attacks embed hidden triggers into DRL models during training, causing models to perform normally under clean environments while executing malicious behaviors upon encountering specific triggers. Existing backdoor attacks against DRL predominantly inherit supervised learning paradigms, relying on handcrafted, instantaneous triggers that activate attacks immediately upon presentation. This paradigm is fundamentally at odds with the sequential decision-making nature of DRL, often leading to detectable behavioral anomalies. To this end, we propose a curiosity-driven spatiotemporal trigger mining mechanism, CurioTrojan, for automated backdoor construction in competitive multi-agent systems. Leveraging random network distillation to implement the curiosity mechanism, CurioTrojan quantifies a victim agent's familiarity with environmental states, autonomously exploring rare observation sequences to generate stealthy triggers. The attacker agent strategically manipulates its behavior to induce these trigger conditions in the victim's observations, thereby activating latent backdoors that subvert the victim's competitive performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our CurioTrojan can achieve stealthy backdoor attacks, which can obtain a 90.2% attack success rate, maintain a clean performance deviation (0.1%), and effectively evade detection by advanced backdoor defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CurioTrojan，一种基于好奇心驱动的时空触发机制挖掘方法，通过在竞争性多智能体系统中自动生成隐蔽的对抗后门触发器，实现了对深度强化学习模型的高隐蔽性后门攻击，攻击成功率达90.2%且清洁性能偏差仅0.1%。
AI.research_question: 如何在竞争性多智能体系统中构建隐蔽、自动化的后门攻击，使其与DRL的序贯决策特性相兼容，并有效规避现有防御机制？
AI.motivation: 现有针对DRL的后门攻击大多继承监督学习范式，依赖手工设计的瞬时触发器，这与DRL的序贯决策本质相悖，容易导致可检测的行为异常。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机网络蒸馏（Random Network Distillation）好奇心机制、时空触发机制、后门攻击理论
AI.method: 利用随机网络蒸馏实现好奇心机制，量化受害智能体对环境状态的熟悉程度，自动探索罕见的观测序列以生成隐蔽触发器；攻击智能体通过策略性行为操控诱发受害者的触发条件，激活潜伏后门。
AI.findings: CurioTrojan实现了90.2%的攻击成功率，清洁性能偏差仅0.1%，能有效规避先进的后门防御检测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出好奇心驱动的时空触发机制，将后门攻击范式从监督学习的瞬时触发拓展到适应DRL序贯决策的时空维度，弥补了现有后门攻击与DRL本质不匹配的理论缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了竞争性多智能体系统中DRL模型面临的新型隐蔽后门威胁，为DRL安全防御研究提供了更具挑战性的攻击基准。

title: Operationalizing Transaction Cost Economics for Contract Governance: Evidence from Procurement Data
affiliations: Air Force Institute of Technology and Air Force Institute of Technology

detail.title: Operationalizing Transaction Cost Economics for Contract Governance: Evidence from Procurement Data
detail.abstract: Selecting an appropriate contract type is a central decision in purchasing and supply management, shaping incentives, risk allocation, and buyer–supplier relationships. Drawing on Transaction Cost Economics (TCE), this study examines how observable procurement characteristics can inform contract governance choice. Using a dataset of over 2,500 U.S. federal service contracts, we develop and test empirical models that relate contract attributes—such as competition structure, subcontracting, performance specifications, and contract value—to governance form (fixed price versus cost plus), providing a large-scale empirical setting with broader implications for procurement and supply chain governance. Our results provide large-sample evidence that commonly available procurement data serve as meaningful proxies for transaction cost dimensions, including asset specificity and complexity. Several contract features are significantly associated with governance choice, supporting TCE predictions, while interaction effects reveal more nuanced relationships. In particular, the findings suggest that asset specificity moderates the influence of complexity on governance selection, highlighting conditional effects that extend prior empirical applications of TCE. Building on these insights, we develop predictive models that use only information available at the time of contract design. These models improve contract-type classification accuracy by approximately 14 percent relative to an informed baseline, demonstrating practical value for procurement decision-making. Overall, the study advances purchasing and supply management research by operationalizing TCE with observable data, offering empirically grounded guidance for contract design, and bridging theory and empirically grounded decision-support approaches for contract design.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于交易成本经济学（TCE），利用美国联邦服务合同数据（超过2,500份），检验可观察的采购特征如何影响合同治理形式（固定价格 vs 成本加成）。研究发现采购数据可作为交易成本维度的代理变量，资产专用性会调节复杂性对治理选择的影响，并开发了预测模型，较基准提升约14%的分类准确率。
AI.research_question: 可观察的采购特征如何影响合同治理形式（固定价格与成本加成）的选择？
AI.motivation: 选择合适的合同类型是采购与供应链管理的核心决策，但以往研究缺乏利用大规模、可观察的采购数据来实证检验交易成本经济学（TCE）对合同治理选择的预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学（TCE），重点关注资产专用性、复杂性等维度。
AI.method: 使用超过2,500份美国联邦服务合同数据集，构建实证模型（包括主效应和交互效应），并开发预测模型进行分类准确性检验。
AI.findings: （1）多项合同特征与治理选择显著相关，支持TCE预测；（2）资产专用性调节复杂性对治理选择的影响，呈现条件效应；（3）基于合同设计阶段可用信息构建的预测模型，分类准确率较基准提升约14%。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）用大规模可观测数据操作化TCE，拓展了TCE在采购领域的实证应用；（2）发现资产专用性与复杂性的交互效应，揭示了条件性影响机制，超越了以往TCE研究。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为采购决策者提供基于实证数据的合同设计指导；（2）开发的预测模型可辅助合同类型选择，提升决策准确性约14%，具有实际应用价值。

title: Quantifying Investor-Driven Overvaluation in the Australian Housing Market: An Empirical Demand Attribution Price Model

detail.title: Quantifying Investor-Driven Overvaluation in the Australian Housing Market: An Empirical Demand Attribution Price Model
detail.abstract: This paper presents an empirical demand-pressure price model to calculate overvaluation of the Australian established housing market sector from 1999 to the present, a period marked by sustained investor demand supported by three generous tax concessions. The price model is intrinsically expressed in the economic fundamental: in a supply limited market demand drives prices up, housing buyer and price data allow market specific implementation of the model and in Australia’s case established housing supply is essentially fixed. Furthermore, buyers account for economic factors in their decision to buy or not along with the bank’s decision on lending to buyers. The model attributes marginal real house price movements to buyer types: first home buyers, non first home buyer owner-occupiers and investors. By tracking relative demand-pressure shifts of each buyer type with corresponding price changes, the model attributes the proportion of price inflation driven by buyer type.While all buyer type demand contributes to house price inflation, only the investorattributable portion is treated as overvaluation, as it is driven primarily by tax distortions and expectations of future capital gains rather than housing consumption needs. This direct approach analysis indicates that approximately 46% of real house prices at the end of 2024 was attributable to investor-induced demand which equates to an 84% overvaluation of the established housing market. The evolution of this overvaluation meets Nobel Laureate Joseph Stiglitz’s definition of an asset bubble with one caveat, it is a rational bubble so long as investors believe the tax concessions will remain in place for the long term, a belief grounded not in economics but in historical political mandate. Notably, since the second tax concession investors own or have owned and traded approximately 9.6 million homes, a number representing 90% of Australia’s 11 million dwellings, illustrating the unprecedented scale of investor dominance in the Australian housing market.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个需求压力价格模型，用于测算澳大利亚存量住房市场1999年至2024年的估值过高程度。研究发现，截至2024年底，约46%的实际房价由投资者需求驱动，相当于84%的估值溢价，并符合斯蒂格利茨定义的理性资产泡沫特征。
AI.research_question: 如何量化澳大利亚存量住房市场中由投资者需求导致的估值过高程度？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚住房市场长期存在三项税收优惠政策，持续刺激投资者需求，但其对房价估值的影响缺乏精准的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求压力价格模型、斯蒂格利茨资产泡沫理论、理性泡沫理论
AI.method: 基于供应有限（存量住房供给基本固定）的假设，将边际实际房价变动归因于三类购房者（首次购房者、非首次自住者、投资者），通过追踪各类购房者的相对需求压力变化与价格变动，分离出投资者驱动的价格通胀部分作为估值过高。
AI.findings: 截至2024年底，约46%的实际房价由投资者需求驱动，对应84%的估值溢价；自第二项税收优惠政策以来，投资者拥有或交易过约960万套住房，占全澳1100万套住房的90%，表明投资者主导市场的空前规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 将需求压力模型应用于住房市场估值分析，区分了消费性需求与投资性需求对房价的不同影响，并证明了澳大利亚住房市场符合理性资产泡沫的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化税收优惠政策对房价扭曲影响的分析工具，揭示了取消或改革住房税收优惠政策的必要性。

title: A Constraint-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Data Augmentation in Binary Strabismus Detection
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Constraint-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Data Augmentation in Binary Strabismus Detection
detail.abstract: Background and Objective:Data augmentation is a prevalent technique in deep learning for medical image analysis, aimed at enhancing generalisation when labelled data are scarce. However, its true impact in resource-limited clinical settings is not yet clear. This study investigates binary strabismus referral classification for esotropia and exotropia using lightweight convolutional neural networks, specifically EfficientNet-B0, MobileNet-V2, and MobileNet-V3. We introduce a constraint-aware benchmarking framework to systematically evaluate whether data augmentation consistently improves upon baseline models across datasets, architectures, and evaluation metrics.Methods:We propose UBAEF, a constraint-aware benchmarking framework designed to evaluate multiple data augmentation strategies under conservative training conditions. Two datasets representing esotropia and exotropia are treated as distinct binary classification tasks. The aforementioned lightweight CNN architectures are employed, with six augmentation strategies compared against a non-augmented baseline. All models are trained under identical pipelines to ensure fair comparisons, with performance metrics including accuracy, specificity, precision, negative predictive value, and Brier score, particularly focusing on calibration through decomposition. Statistical significance of results is assessed using the DeLong test and the McNemar test.Results:Overall, data augmentation did not consistently exceed baseline performance across models. In several instances, augmented models exhibited slight declines in accuracy, specificity, precision, and negative predictive value, while baseline models remained competitive. Dataset-specific analyses revealed that AutoAugment and TrivialAugment occasionally enhanced performance in esotropia, whereas CutMix underperformed. In the exotropia dataset, TrivialAugment proved to be relatively stable. Variation in model performance indicated that augmentation effects were architecture dependent. Statistical assessments using the DeLong and McNemar tests revealed no consistent significant improvements. Calibration analysis indicated that Mixup achieved the highest reliability and AutoAugment demonstrated the strongest resolution, though these effects were inconsistent across conditions.Conclusions:This study presents a benchmarking framework addressing constraints for evaluating data augmentation in binary strabismus referral classification, especially in low-resource settings. The investigated augmentation methods did not consistently enhance performance compared to baseline models and often resulted in slight performance degradation. Their efficacy varied by dataset and architecture, underscoring the importance of context. Hence, selective use of data augmentation is advised in clinical environments, with AutoAugment being seen as the most consistent for constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个约束感知的基准测试框架UBAEF，系统评估数据增强在轻量级CNN（EfficientNet-B0, MobileNet-V2, MobileNet-V3）用于斜视转诊分类（内斜视和外斜视）中的效果。结果显示，数据增强并未持续优于基线模型，有时甚至导致性能下降，其效果因数据集和架构而异，建议在临床环境中选择性使用增强方法，其中AutoAugment在受限条件下表现最稳定。
AI.research_question: 在资源有限的临床环境中，数据增强技术是否能够持续提升轻量级卷积神经网络用于斜视（内斜视和外斜视）二元转诊分类的性能？
AI.motivation: 尽管数据增强在医学图像分析中被广泛用于提升模型泛化能力，但其在资源受限的真实临床环境中的实际效果尚不明确。现有研究缺乏系统的约束感知评估框架，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于轻量级CNN架构（EfficientNet-B0, MobileNet-V2, MobileNet-V3）的迁移学习；数据增强理论（包括AutoAugment, TrivialAugment, CutMix, Mixup等策略）；模型校准理论（通过Brier分数分解评估可靠性、分辨率和不确定性）。
AI.method: 提出UBAEF约束感知基准框架；使用两个数据集分别代表内斜视和外斜视的二元分类任务；比较六种数据增强策略与非增强基线；采用相同训练管线确保公平性；评估指标包括准确性、特异性、精确度、负预测值和Brier分数；使用DeLong检验和McNemar检验进行统计显著性评估。
AI.findings: 数据增强未持续超越基线性能，有时甚至导致准确率、特异性、精确度和负预测值的轻微下降；AutoAugment和TrivialAugment在内斜视中偶有提升，CutMix表现较差；TrivialAugment在外斜视中相对稳定；增强效果具有架构依赖性；统计检验未显示一致显著改进；校准分析中Mixup可靠性最高，AutoAugment分辨率最强，但效果不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个约束感知的数据增强评估框架（UBAEF），系统揭示了数据增强在资源受限临床环境中并非总是有效，挑战了"数据增强总是有益"的普遍假设；揭示了增强效果对数据集和架构的依赖性，为理解数据增强的条件有效性提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床环境中的数据增强使用提供了具体建议：应选择性使用数据增强，推荐AutoAugment作为受限条件下最一致的选择；为低资源医疗环境中的轻量级CNN部署提供了实践指导，避免盲目应用数据增强可能导致的性能下降。

title: Choosing between CNN and Transformer for coronary CTA stenosis grading: A systematic comparison across 18 architectures
affiliations: Hebei University, Hebei University, Hebei University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Hebei University

detail.title: Choosing between CNN and Transformer for coronary CTA stenosis grading: A systematic comparison across 18 architectures
detail.abstract: Objective: To systematically benchmark 18 deep learning architectures for five-class coronary artery stenosis grading on CTA curved planar reformation (CPR) images, encompassing CNNs, lightweight networks,  Vision Transformer (ViT) and Swin Transformer.Methods: We retrospectively collected 5,078 CPR images from the Affiliated Hospital of Hebei University (2,337 nonstenotic, 588 mild (1-24%), 955 mild (25-49%), 460 moderate (50-69%), and 738 severe (≥70%)). The mild (1-24%), moderate, and severe categories were doubled by 90°rotation, resulting in 6,864 images. All images were center-cropped and resized to 224×224 pixels. A total of 18 representative deep learning architectures were selected for benchmarking, spanning classic CNNs (e.g., GoogLeNet, ResNet, DenseNet), lightweight networks (e.g., MobileNet, ShuffleNet, MobileViT), and Vision Transformers (ViT, Swin Transformer). All models were uniformly trained from scratch using the cross-entropy loss function to ensure a fair comparison under limited medical data conditions.Results: EfficientNetV2 achieved the highest accuracy (85.86%) and weighted Kappa (0.7877). ResNeXt101 (83.56%), EfficientNet (83.16%), and ResNet50 (82.91%) also performed well. MobileViT reached 81.85% accuracy with 0.95 M parameters and 0.81 ms inference time, representing an optimal efficiency-accuracy trade-off suitable for edge deployment. ViT (61.37%) and Swin Transformer (62.83%) significantly underperformed CNNs, likely due to the lack of pre-training. Moderate stenosis (50–69%) yielded the lowest F1 score (77.27%) across all models.Conclusions: This study provides a quantitative benchmark for AI-assisted coronary stenosis grading. EfficientNetV2 is recommended when accuracy is the priority. MobileViT and ShuffleNet offer good accuracyefficiency tradeoffs for resourcelimited settings. This study provides a benchmark for model selection in AIassisted coronary stenosis grading.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统性地在CTA曲面重建图像上对18种深度学习架构进行五分类冠状动脉狭窄分级基准测试，发现EfficientNetV2准确率最高（85.86%），MobileViT在精度与效率间取得最佳平衡，而纯Vision Transformer因缺乏预训练显著逊色于CNN。
AI.research_question: 在CTA曲面重建图像上，不同深度学习架构（包括经典CNN、轻量级网络和Vision Transformer）在五类冠状动脉狭窄分级任务中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉狭窄的准确分级对冠心病诊断和治疗至关重要，但缺乏对多种深度学习架构在CTA CPR图像上的系统性基准比较，尤其缺乏对轻量级网络和Transformer架构的评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习图像分类理论，包括卷积神经网络（CNN）的特征提取机制、轻量级网络的高效计算设计（如深度可分离卷积、通道混洗）以及Vision Transformer的自注意力机制原理。
AI.method: 回顾性收集5,078张CTA CPR图像，通过90°旋转对部分类别进行数据增强至6,864张；图像中心裁剪并缩放至224×224像素；统一使用交叉熵损失函数从头训练18种代表性深度学习架构（包括GoogLeNet、ResNet、DenseNet、MobileNet、ShuffleNet、MobileViT、ViT、Swin Transformer等），对比准确率、加权Kappa、F1分数、参数量和推理时间等指标。
AI.findings: EfficientNetV2取得最高准确率（85.86%）和加权Kappa（0.7877）；MobileViT以0.95M参数和0.81ms推理时间达到81.85%准确率，适合边缘部署；ViT（61.37%）和Swin Transformer（62.83%）因缺乏预训练显著低于CNN；中度狭窄（50-69%）在所有模型中F1分数最低（77.27%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在CTA CPR图像上对涵盖CNN、轻量级网络和Vision Transformer的18种深度学习架构进行系统性基准测试，揭示了在有限医疗数据条件下Transformer架构需预训练才能发挥优势的理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI辅助冠状动脉狭窄分级提供了模型选择指南：追求准确率首选EfficientNetV2，资源受限场景推荐MobileViT和ShuffleNet；定量比较了各模型的精度-效率权衡，为实际临床部署提供参考依据。

title: Are Day-of-the-Week Effects in Cryptocurrencies Real?  Intraday Evidence from Active and Less Active Cryptocurrencies​
affiliations: University of Rhode Island - Area of Finance and Insurance, University of Michigan at Flint and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Are Day-of-the-Week Effects in Cryptocurrencies Real?  Intraday Evidence from Active and Less Active Cryptocurrencies​
detail.abstract: This study revisits calendar anomalies in cryptocurrency markets using hourly data for four actively traded cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether USDt, and BNB) and eight less active cryptocurrencies. While prior studies based on daily returns provide mixed evidence on day-of-the-week (DoW) effects, we show that these patterns are not persistent daily phenomena. Instead, they are driven by a limited number of intraday intervals and do not reflect broad daily behavior.We further document that these effects are localized, asset-specific, and more pronounced among actively traded cryptocurrencies, while largely absent among less active ones.Overall, the findings indicate that cryptocurrency markets exhibit limited and short-lived inefficiencies rather than persistent anomalies. This highlights the importance of employing high-frequency data in studies of continuously traded markets and suggests that digital asset investors may benefit from the presence of abnormal returns only in a limited number of hours on specific days of the week.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用小时级高频数据重新审视加密货币市场的日历异常现象，发现所谓的"星期几效应"并非持续的每日现象，而是由少数日内时间段驱动，且这些效应是局部、资产特异性的，在交易活跃的加密货币中更明显。总体而言，加密货币市场存在有限且短暂的无效性，而非持续性异常。
AI.research_question: 加密货币市场是否存在持续的星期几效应（日历异常）？这些模式是日内现象还是每日现象？
AI.motivation: 以往基于日度数据的研究对加密货币市场是否存在星期几效应存在混合证据，本研究采用小时级高频数据以更精确地检验这些日历异常是否真正存在且持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场有效性假说（EMH）、日历异常（Calendar Anomalies）、星期几效应（Day-of-the-Week Effect）
AI.method: 采用小时级高频数据，分析四种交易活跃的加密货币（比特币、以太坊、USDT、BNB）和八种交易不活跃的加密货币，对比日内价格模式与日度价格模式。
AI.findings: (1) 星期几效应并非持续的每日现象，而是由少数日内时间段驱动；(2) 这些效应是局部、资产特异性的；(3) 在交易活跃的加密货币中更明显，在交易不活跃的加密货币中基本不存在；(4) 加密货币市场仅存在有限且短暂的无效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 对市场有效性假说提供了新的实证证据，表明加密货币市场虽存在短期无效性但非持续性异常，并强调了在连续交易市场中使用高频数据的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字资产投资者提供了关于异常收益窗口的精准信息，即仅在特定星期几的有限小时内可能存在套利机会，有助于优化交易策略。

title: Technology, Talent, and High-Quality Development in China: Time-Varying Evidence on Macroeconomic Resilience
affiliations: Changchun University of Technology and Changchun University of Technology

detail.title: Technology, Talent, and High-Quality Development in China: Time-Varying Evidence on Macroeconomic Resilience
detail.abstract: As China moves from factor-driven expansion toward high-quality development, a key question is how technological change can be translated into sustained productivity growth and macroeconomic resilience. This paper investigates how technology- and talent-related factors jointly shape high-quality development in China. Using quarterly macroeconomic data from 2007Q1 to 2024Q4, this study combines a stochastic-volatility time-varying-parameter factor-augmented vector autoregression (SV-TVP-FAVAR) model with a Markov-switching autoregressive (MS-AR) framework to identify their time-varying effects on total factor productivity and macroeconomic regime transitions. The results show that technological factors generate a faster and stronger short-run impulse, whereas talent factors play a slower but more persistent stabilising role. Neither factor alone is sufficient to support durable high-quality development: technological upgrading without effective talent absorption produces limited long-run gains, while talent accumulation without continued technological transformation has weaker productivity effects. By contrast, their joint effect more effectively supports transitions from lower-growth to higher-growth regimes and helps sustain macroeconomic stability. These findings suggest that the developmental value of technological change depends not only on innovation input, but also on talent formation, policy coordination, and the institutional capacity to convert technological advances into productive outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文运用SV-TVP-FAVAR和MS-AR模型，基于2007Q1-2024Q4中国宏观季度数据，发现技术因素对全要素生产率有更强更快的短期冲击，人才因素则发挥更慢但更持久的稳定作用；两者协同才能有效推动经济向高增长区间转换并维持宏观稳定。
AI.research_question: 技术因素与人才因素如何共同塑造中国的高质量发展？
AI.motivation: 中国正从要素驱动扩张转向高质量发展，关键在于理解技术变革如何转化为持续的生产力增长和宏观经济韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-人才协同效应理论、全要素生产率增长理论、宏观经济体制转换理论
AI.method: 采用随机波动时变参数因子增强向量自回归（SV-TVP-FAVAR）模型与马尔可夫转换自回归（MS-AR）框架相结合。
AI.findings: 技术因素短期冲击更强更快，人才因素更慢但更持久；两者单独作用均不足以支撑持久高质量发展，但协同效应能更有效支持向高增长区间转换并维持宏观稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术与人才在推动高质量发展中的非对称动态机制和协同互补效应，丰富了发展经济学中关于要素协同的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：技术变革的发展价值不仅取决于创新投入，还取决于人才培养、政策协调以及将技术进步转化为生产性成果的制度能力。

title: JUE Insight: The Effect of 2012-2021 Building Code Revisions on Break-Even Rents of 3-story Apartments
affiliations: Purdue University - Department of Economics, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: JUE Insight: The Effect of 2012-2021 Building Code Revisions on Break-Even Rents of 3-story Apartments
detail.abstract: Building codes establish minimum construction standards for new multifamily housing, yet their cumulative implications for rental affordability remain poorly understood. Between 2012 and 2021, the International Code Council adopted 130 revisions to the International Building Code affecting multifamily development. Using a detailed prototype of a three-story apartment building and holding material prices and labor productivity constant at 2024 levels, we find that 16 of these revisions raised national average construction costs by 9.9 percent relative to a 2009 baseline, with fire protection requirements accounting for 67 percent of the dollar-weighted increase. Translating these costs into break-even rents using local land prices and capitalization rates, the implied increase in monthly rent for a two-bedroom unit ranges from $134 to $222 across the most populous cities in each state, equivalent to an additional 3.4 percentage points of median renter income at the national average. The affordability burden falls disproportionately on renters in lower-income non-coastal markets, where the ratio of regulatory cost to baseline development cost is highest.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，2012-2021年间国际建筑规范(International Building Code)的130项修订中，有16项使多层公寓建设成本中位数上升9.9%，其中消防要求占成本增长的67%。这些成本转化为每套两居室月租金增加134-222美元，相当于租户收入中位数的3.4个百分点，且对低收入非沿海市场的负担更重。
AI.research_question: 建筑规范的累积修订对多户住宅租赁可负担性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 建筑规范制定了新建多户住宅的最低施工标准，但其对租赁可负担性的累积影响尚不清楚。现有文献缺乏对建筑规范变更如何通过成本传导影响租金的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建筑规范成本传导理论：规范修订→建造成本变化→资本化率与土地价格→盈亏平衡租金→租户收入负担比例。
AI.method: 以三层公寓楼的详细原型为基准，保持2024年材料价格和劳动生产率不变，量化130项规范修订中16项影响成本的变化；结合各州最大城市的土地价格和资本化率，将成本转化为盈亏平衡租金。
AI.findings: 16项修订使全国平均建造成本相对2009年基线上升9.9%；消防要求占成本增量的67%；两居室月租金增加134-222美元（各州最大城市之间），相当于全国平均租户收入中位数的3.4个百分点；非沿海低收入市场的监管成本与基线开发成本之比最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了建筑规范累积修订对租赁住房可负担性的影响，揭示了监管成本通过租金渠道向租户传导的机制，并发现成本负担在低收入非沿海市场更为严重。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了建筑规范修订对住房可负担性影响的量化证据，提示在修订规范时需权衡安全收益与租金成本上升之间的平衡，尤其关注对低收入和非沿海市场的差异化影响。

title: Opportunity Zones and the Housing Supply
affiliations: University of South Carolina

detail.title: Opportunity Zones and the Housing Supply
detail.abstract: I study whether the Opportunity Zones (OZ) program, one of the largest place-based development subsidies in U.S. history, generated new housing or merely reallocated development. Using a quarterly panel of residential address counts for all U.S. Census tracts from 2012 to 2025, I document that OZ designation displaced residential development from nearby tracts: non-OZ tracts within ten miles of a designated zone experienced a decline in address growth that mirrors the measured gain inside OZ boundaries, consistent with developers relocating projects across tract lines to capture the tax benefit rather than initiating new ones. Apparent housing gains inside designated tracts are fully attributable to development displaced from nearby communities. Formal tests of the combined effect fail to reject zero at conventional significance levels, casting doubt on the efficacy of the proposed expansion of OZ-style incentives in theOne Big Beautiful Bill Act for stimulating housing production absent complementary zoning or infrastructure reform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国"机会区"（OZ）计划是否真正创造了新的住房开发，或者只是重新分配了现有开发活动。利用2012年至2025年美国所有人口普查区的季度住宅地址数量面板数据，发现OZ指定导致了附近非OZ区域的住宅开发减少，其减少幅度与OZ边界内的增长幅度相当。OZ区域内看似增长的住房完全来自于附近社区的开发转移。统计检验未能拒绝总体效应为零的假设，质疑了大规模扩张OZ式激励措施（如《一项大而美的法案》所提议的）在缺乏配套的区划或基础设施改革的情况下刺激住房生产的有效性。
AI.research_question: 美国机会区（OZ）计划是否真正创造了新的住房开发，还是仅仅将开发活动从邻近地区重新分配到指定区域？
AI.motivation: OZ计划是美国历史上最大的基于地点的开发补贴之一，但其实际效果（尤其是是否存在净新增住房）存在严重争议。当前政策讨论中有人提议大规模扩张OZ式激励措施，因此需要严谨评估该计划是否真正刺激了住房生产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地点的开发补贴理论；税收激励对开发活动空间再分配的影响；住房供给弹性的空间异质性。
AI.method: 利用2012-2025年美国所有人口普查区的季度住宅地址数量面板数据，采用双重差分法（DID）比较OZ指定区域与非OZ区域的住房开发变化，并特别关注空间溢出效应——即分析OZ指定对10英里范围内非OZ区域的开发影响。
AI.findings: OZ指定导致非OZ区域（10英里范围内）的住宅地址增长下降，其下降幅度与OZ边界内的增长幅度相匹配；OZ区域内的住房增长完全来自附近社区的开发转移；统计检验未能拒绝总体效应为零的假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于地点补贴会导致开发活动空间再分配而非净新增的实证证据；揭示了税收激励政策在缺乏配套改革（如区划和基础设施改革）时的局限性；为"位移效应"文献提供了大规模的准实验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对当前美国政策讨论（如《一项大而美的法案》中OZ式激励的扩张）提供了重要警示：仅靠税收激励无法有效刺激住房生产，必须辅以区划和基础设施改革；为地方政府和联邦政府优化基于地点的补贴政策设计提供了实证依据。

title: A Study on the Estimation of Green Production Efficiency in Larimichthys Crocea Aquaculture and Its Influencing Factors
affiliations: Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University, Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University and Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University

detail.title: A Study on the Estimation of Green Production Efficiency in Larimichthys Crocea Aquaculture and Its Influencing Factors
detail.abstract: The larimichthys crocea is one of the most important commercially farmed marine fish species along China’s southeastern coast. Although the green transition of aquaculture has begun to show results at the macro level, there has been a lack of systematic assessment of green production efficiency at the micro level of individual farmers. Based on micro-level survey data from 117 aquaculture farmers in the main larimichthys crocea production areas of Fujian Province, this study employs an SBM-DEA model incorporating unplanned outputs to measure the industry’s green production efficiency and uses a Tobit regression model to identify its key influencing factors. The results indicate: (1) The average green production efficiency of aquaculture farmers is 0.681, with only 18.80% reaching the efficiency frontier, indicating significant variation among individuals; (2) The average scale efficiency was only 0.619, with 85.47% of the samples in the stage of increasing returns to scale; insufficient scale was the primary source of efficiency loss, and efficiency gains were concentrated in the transition from small to medium scale; (3) The efficiency difference between the traditional and ecological models did not pass the 5% significance test, and the independent driving effect of the technical model was not yet significant during the facility renovation transition period; (4) Educational attainment and farming experience have significant negative effects on efficiency, with marginal effects of -0.064 and -0.006, respectively; path dependence and the level of focus in part-time, decentralized management are possible underlying mechanisms. The study indicates that scale thresholds and human capital lock-in effects are the primary obstacles currently constraining the improvement of green production efficiency in the larimichthys crocea industry.

AI.tldr: 基于福建省117户大黄鱼养殖户的微观调查数据，研究发现养殖户的绿色生产效率平均为0.681，仅18.80%达到效率前沿；规模效率均值仅0.619，85.47%处于规模报酬递增阶段；传统模式与生态模式的效率差异不显著；受教育年限和养殖经验对效率有显著负向影响。规模门槛和人力资本锁定效应是当前制约产业绿色生产效率提升的主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 大黄鱼养殖户的绿色生产效率如何？其关键影响因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 宏观层面水产养殖绿色转型已初见成效，但微观层面对个体养殖户绿色生产效率的系统评估尚缺，而大黄鱼是中国东南沿海最重要的商业化养殖海水鱼类之一，亟需从微观视角识别效率及其影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色生产效率理论、规模经济理论、人力资本理论、路径依赖理论
AI.method: 采用SBM-DEA模型（含非期望产出）测量绿色生产效率，运用Tobit回归模型识别关键影响因素。
AI.findings: (1)平均绿色生产效率0.681，个体差异大；(2)平均规模效率仅0.619，85.47%处于规模报酬递增阶段，规模不足是效率损失主因；(3)传统模式与生态模式效率差异不显著，技术模式的独立驱动效应尚未显现；(4)受教育年限和经验对效率有显著负向影响，路径依赖和兼业化、分散经营的关注度不足可能是深层机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了水产养殖微观层面的绿色生产效率异质性，识别了规模门槛和人力资本锁定效应作为制约绿色效率提升的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大黄鱼产业政策制定提供了微观证据，提示应关注养殖规模门槛和人力资本结构优化，而非简单推进技术模式转型。

title: More Comfortable Living, Wider Consumption Gaps? The Impact of China's "15-Minute Convenient Living Circle" Pilot Policy on Urban Consumption
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Hunan Agricultural University and Zhongnan University of Economics and Law

detail.title: More Comfortable Living, Wider Consumption Gaps? The Impact of China's "15-Minute Convenient Living Circle" Pilot Policy on Urban Consumption
detail.abstract: This paper studies how a community-level service intervention reshapes urban consumption patterns. We exploit China's "15-minute Convenient Living Circle" (CLC) pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment and combine it with high-frequency transaction data from 2018 to 2022 to estimate the causal effects of this policy on consumption behavior. We find that the CLC policy significantly increases aggregate consumption, while simultaneously shifting consumption toward more advantaged locations and thereby widening spatial inequality both within and across cities. The effects are stronger in larger and less-aging cities and are concentrated in service-oriented sectors. Mechanism analyses suggest that the policy operates in part through changes in transportation accessibility, local service density, and population mobility. Our findings highlight the role of place-based service interventions in shaping urban consumption patterns and reveal a trade-off between consumption growth and spatial inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国"15分钟便民生活圈"试点政策和高频交易数据，发现该政策在促进消费增长的同时，加剧了城市内和城市间的空间消费不平等，揭示了社区服务干预在消费增长与空间公平之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 社区层面的服务干预如何重塑城市消费模式？具体而言，"15分钟便民生活圈"政策对居民消费行为和空间消费不平等有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注社区级服务干预对城市消费的空间分布影响，尤其是消费增长与空间不平等之间的潜在权衡关系尚未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方法服务干预理论、城市消费空间分布理论、消费增长与空间不平等权衡理论。
AI.method: 利用中国"15分钟便民生活圈"试点政策作为准自然实验，结合2018-2022年高频交易数据，采用因果推断方法估计政策对消费行为的因果效应。
AI.findings: (1) CLC政策显著提升了总消费水平；(2) 但同时将消费向更优势区位转移，加剧了城市内和城市间的空间不平等；(3) 效应在大城市和老龄化程度低的城市更强；(4) 效应集中在服务导向型行业；(5) 机制涉及交通可达性、本地服务密度和人口流动的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示社区级服务干预在促进消费增长与加剧空间不平等之间的权衡关系，丰富了地方法干预与城市消费空间分布的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于"15分钟便民生活圈"政策的全面效果评估，提示在推行此类社区服务干预时需关注其可能带来的空间不平等加剧问题。

title: The Energy–Logistics–Cost Nexus: Assessing LCOE Volatility, Decarbonization Barriers, and SDG 7 Alignment
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Energy–Logistics–Cost Nexus: Assessing LCOE Volatility, Decarbonization Barriers, and SDG 7 Alignment
detail.abstract: As the global energy transition matures, analytical focus has shifted from isolated engineering performance toward integrated system-level economic efficiency. While the Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) remains the universal metric for evaluating project viability, traditional models are largely static, failing to incorporate the profound financial impacts of supply chain performance, logistical volatility, and institutional constraints. This study addresses these "integration gaps" by examining the relationship between logistical system conditions, operational disruptions, and sustainability outcomes.Adopting a critical realist perspective and a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design, the research utilizes semi-structured interviews with industry experts to identify sources of operational friction, followed by Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and the development of an Integrated LCOE (I-LCOE) model. Central to the study is the Dynamic Logistics–Sustainability Integration Model, which conceptualizes renewable energy systems as interconnected layers where logistical agility directly influences financial risk.The findings establish logistics as a primary structural cost driver embedded across all project lifecycle phases. The research identifies "logistical velocity" as a critical determinant of the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), as supply chain friction serves as an aggressive risk multiplier that inflates investor risk premiums. Furthermore, physical upscaling of components introduces non-linear logistical constraints that traditional models fail to capture. The study proposes an integrated digital knowledge management platform to resolve information asymmetry. By internalizing traditionally externalized variables such as geopolitical disruptions at maritime chokepoints this research provides a transformative framework for achieving SDG 7 and optimizing the systemic costs of global decarbonization.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出集成化LCOE（I-LCOE）模型，揭示物流系统性能、运营中断与可持续性成果之间的动态关系，证明物流速度是加权平均资本成本（WACC）的关键决定因素，并提出数字化知识管理平台以解决信息不对称问题。
AI.research_question: 物流系统条件、运营中断与可持续性成果之间存在怎样的关系？传统LCOE模型如何通过纳入供应链绩效和制度约束实现改进？
AI.motivation: 传统LCOE模型是静态的，未能纳入供应链绩效、物流波动性和制度约束等对项目财务绩效产生深远影响的因素，存在"整合鸿沟"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判现实主义视角；动态物流-可持续性整合模型（将可再生能源系统视为互联层，物流敏捷性直接影响财务风险）。
AI.method: 顺序解释性混合方法设计：第一阶段半结构化专家访谈识别运营摩擦来源；第二阶段结构方程模型（SEM）及I-LCOE模型开发。
AI.findings: 1）物流是贯穿项目全生命周期的结构性成本驱动因素；2）"物流速度"是WACC的关键决定因素，供应链摩擦是风险倍增器，推高投资者风险溢价；3）组件物理尺度升级带来传统模型未能捕捉的非线性物流约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了动态物流-可持续性整合模型，将物流敏捷性概念化为财务风险的前因变量；揭示了物流速度与WACC之间的理论机制，拓展了能源经济学与供应链理论的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出I-LCOE模型，将地缘政治 disruptions（如海上咽喉点）等外生变量内部化；建议构建集成化数字知识管理平台以解决信息不对称；为优化全球脱碳的系统性成本、实现SDG 7提供变革性框架。

title: Coordinating hydrogen valley design with global energy systems and local constraints and opportunities - Part 1: Methodology
affiliations: Mines Paris - PSL, , affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Mines Paris - PSL

detail.title: Coordinating hydrogen valley design with global energy systems and local constraints and opportunities - Part 1: Methodology
detail.abstract: To achieve the energy transition, low-carbon hydrogen is considered as a key lever. Its deployment is expected to revolve around specific industrial hubs, commonly referred to as ``hydrogen valleys". These territories generally combine existing uses of fossil-based hydrogen with significant potential for future demand. However, their development raises several major challenges: resource availability, land use management, and the need for coordination with national or continental energy strategies. Moreover, local opportunities for synergies and infrastructure optimization can influence the equilibrium of the broader energy system, notably by shifting territorial attractiveness, hence, hydrogen demand, and investment needs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid methodological framework combining two complementary modeling approaches. The first, based on MIRET-EU, a TIMES model of the European energy system, assesses the competitiveness of hydrogen relative to other energy carriers and identifies opportunities for local production within a global transition context. The second, based on PHOENIX, a MILP model for industrial zone optimization, designs local infrastructure by integrating territorial constraints such as resource availability, land use management, and synergy opportunities. The iterative loop between the two models is the strength of the methodological framework: European energy transition scenarios generated by MIRET-EU serve as inputs for PHOENIX, which then optimizes the local hydrogen value chain. Local results are subsequently fed back into MIRET-EU to adjust the system equilibrium. Through successive iterations, the approach converges toward a solution that is coherent with both macro-energy planning and territorial feasibility. This paper is the first of a series of two articles and focuses on the methodological framework. The second paper will demonstrate its relevance through a real case study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合宏观能源系统模型（MIRET-EU）与局部工业区优化模型（PHOENIX）的混合方法论框架，通过迭代循环实现欧洲氢谷发展与能源转型的宏观-微观一致性规划。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够同时兼顾宏观能源系统均衡与局部地形约束的混合建模框架，以支持低氢谷（hydrogen valleys）的规划与发展？
AI.motivation: 氢谷的发展面临资源可用性、土地利用管理、与国家级/欧洲级能源战略协调等多重挑战，且局部基础设施优化机会可能反过来影响整个能源系统的均衡。现有单一模型难以同时处理宏观与微观层面的交互问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) TIMES模型（MIRET-EU）：用于宏观欧洲能源系统建模，评估氢相对于其他能源载体的竞争力；2) MILP混合整数线性规划模型（PHOENIX）：用于工业区局部基础设施优化，整合资源、土地和协同机会等约束。两者通过迭代循环实现宏观-微观一致性。
AI.method: 混合方法论框架：宏观层使用MIRET-EU（TIMES模型）生成欧洲能源转型情景，微观层使用PHOENIX（MILP模型）优化局部氢价值链；两者通过迭代循环反馈，逐步收敛至宏观能源规划与地形可行性一致的解决方案。
AI.findings: 本文为系列文章的第一篇，聚焦方法论框架的提出与描述，尚未呈现实证结果。主要发现是：该迭代混合框架能够协调宏观能源系统均衡与局部地形约束，为氢谷规划提供一致性的决策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将宏观能源系统模型（TIMES）与局部基础设施优化模型（MILP）通过迭代循环相结合的方法论创新，弥补了单一模型在氢谷规划中宏观-微观脱节的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和产业规划者提供了一种可操作的工具，能够在氢谷选址与发展中同时考虑国家能源战略与局部资源、土地、协同等实际约束，提高规划的现实可行性与一致性。

title: AI-assisted reliability-constrained design and real-time optimization of circular waste-to-methanol systems under feedstock uncertainty
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University, Sejong University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Sungkyunkwan University

detail.title: AI-assisted reliability-constrained design and real-time optimization of circular waste-to-methanol systems under feedstock uncertainty
detail.abstract: Circular production systems from waste-derived feedstocks are essential for advancing sustainable and resource-efficient operations. However, their deployment is challenged by inherent feedstock variability, which can adversely affect process stability, efficiency, and safe operation. This study proposes a reliability-constrained framework for the design and real-time optimization of a methanol production process from biogas. First, a process model of the integrated reforming and methanol synthesis system was developed to generate performance data. A residual neural network surrogate was then constructed to capture process behavior with low computational cost, achieving high predictive accuracy (R2 > 0.94). Multi-objective optimization using NSGA-II was applied to identify optimal operating strategies considering unit production cost (UPC), net carbon emissions (NCE), exergy efficiency (EXF), and methanol production of three configurations (P1–P3). The results show that the optimal methanol production rate, UPC, NCE, and EXF reached 346 kg/h, 0.63 USD/kg, −0.86 kg CO2/kg, and 50%, respectively, under different objective functions. In the real-time optimization of 30 days operation (a target reliability of 98%), P2 achieves superior robustness, maintaining stable production and reducing cumulative CO2 emissions by 8,300 kg, while P1 exhibits instability and frequent reliability violations. Overall, the framework enables reliable and adaptive operation under feedstock uncertainty, supporting resilient biogas-to-methanol production systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种可靠性约束框架，用于设计及实时优化沼气制甲醇过程，通过残差神经网络代理模型和NSGA-II多目标优化，在原料不确定性下实现了高效、稳定和低排放的甲醇生产。
AI.research_question: 如何在原料（沼气）可变性影响下，设计并实时优化一个兼具可靠性、经济性、低碳排放和高能效的甲醇生产过程？
AI.motivation: 循环生产系统依赖废弃物衍生原料，但原料成分波动会严重影响工艺稳定性、效率和安全性，现有研究缺乏在不确定性下兼顾可靠性与多目标优化的系统框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可靠性工程、多目标优化（NSGA-II）、残差神经网络代理建模、过程系统工程、循环经济理论。
AI.method: 1. 建立集成重整与甲醇合成系统的过程模型以生成性能数据；2. 构建残差神经网络（ResNet）代理模型替代高成本物理模型；3. 采用NSGA-II算法对三种配置（P1–P3）进行多目标优化（UPC、NCE、EXF、甲醇产量）；4. 进行30天实时优化运行，以98%目标可靠性验证各配置的鲁棒性。
AI.findings: 最优工况下甲醇产量346 kg/h，UPC 0.63 USD/kg，NCE −0.86 kg CO₂/kg，EXF 50%。30天实时优化中，P2配置表现出最佳鲁棒性，稳定生产且减少累计CO₂排放8,300 kg；P1则出现不稳定和频繁的可靠性违规。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可靠性约束与多目标优化相结合，拓展了循环生产系统在原料不确定性下的过程设计理论；验证了残差神经网络在复杂化工过程代理建模中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沼气制甲醇工厂提供了一套可在原料波动下自适应优化的决策框架，有助于提升工艺可靠性和经济效益，减少碳足迹，推动废弃物资源化利用的工程实践。

title: Techno-Economic Optimization of Seasonal Cold Thermal Energy Storage: Integrated Operation Scheduling and Storage Sizing under Time-of-Use Tariffs
affiliations: Jiangsu University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Techno-Economic Optimization of Seasonal Cold Thermal Energy Storage: Integrated Operation Scheduling and Storage Sizing under Time-of-Use Tariffs
detail.abstract: Seasonal cold thermal energy storage (SCTES) has emerged as a promising strategy for reducing cooling energy consumption, peak electricity demand, and associated carbon emissions by utilizing naturally available winter cold energy for summer cooling applications. However, the economic feasibility of SCTES remains uncertain because storage capacity, operational scheduling, and electricity tariff structures interact in complex ways that strongly influence lifecycle performance. This study develops a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP)-based techno-economic optimization framework that simultaneously determines storage sizing and hourly operation scheduling under Korean time-of-use tariffs, using building energy management system data from a Korean research campus and a 30-year lifecycle assessment period. Results show that SCTES can reduce peak chiller operation and electricity costs, with seasonal-only operation achieving the most favorable performance at approximately 20-30% storage capacity, while integrated seasonal and peak-shift operation exhibits lower LCOS at moderate storage levels but deteriorating economics with oversized storage. These findings indicate that tariff-sensitive operational scheduling and optimized storage sizing are more influential than storage capacity alone, providing a practical framework for designing cost-effective SCTES systems under realistic operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了基于混合整数线性规划（MILP）的技术经济优化框架，用于分析季节性冷热能储存（SCTES）在韩国分时电价下的经济可行性。研究发现，在20-30%存储容量下采用纯季节性运行模式表现最优，而存储容量过大反而会恶化经济性，表明优化调度和容量设计比单纯扩大存储更关键。
AI.research_question: 季节性冷热能储存（SCTES）系统在韩国分时电价体系下的经济可行性如何？存储容量、运行调度与电价结构如何共同影响其全生命周期经济表现？
AI.motivation: SCTES被认为可降低制冷能耗、峰值电力需求和碳排放，但其经济可行性尚不确定，因为存储容量、运行调度和电价结构之间存在复杂的交互作用，且缺乏同时优化容量和调度的综合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）技术经济优化模型；全生命周期成本分析；分时电价（TOU）下的运行调度理论。
AI.method: 基于MILP的优化框架，同时确定存储容量和小时级运行调度；使用韩国研究园区的建筑能源管理系统数据；设置30年生命周期评估周期；考虑韩国分时电价。
AI.findings: （1）SCTES可降低峰值制冷机组运行和电费；（2）纯季节性运行在约20-30%存储容量下表现最优；（3）季节性+削峰联合运行在中低存储容量下LCOS较低，但存储过大时经济性恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了同时优化SCTES系统容量与小时级运行调度的MILP框架，揭示了存储容量、调度策略与电价结构之间的非线性交互作用机制，为分时电价下季节性储能的经济性评估提供了理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SCTES系统设计提供了实用框架：优化调度和容量设计比单纯扩大存储容量更重要；给出了韩国分时电价下SCTES的最优容量范围（20-30%），有助于降低实际项目的投资风险。

title: Degradation-Aware Electric Vehicle Charging Optimisation Considering Calendar and Cycle Ageing Under Realistic Operating Conditions​
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Degradation-Aware Electric Vehicle Charging Optimisation Considering Calendar and Cycle Ageing Under Realistic Operating Conditions​
detail.abstract: Battery degradation is increasingly recognised as the dominant cost factor in electric vehicle (EV) charging, yet it is often neglected or simplified in existing optimisation strategies. This paper proposes a degradation-aware decentralised charging framework that jointly minimises electricity acquisition cost and battery ageing cost, explicitly accounting for both calendar and cycle degradation mechanisms under realistic operating conditions.A semi-empirical ageing model is implemented for NMC lithium-ion cells, capturing the influence of temperature, state of charge and cycling conditions. Degradation is monetised using real battery market data and incorporated into a nonlinear programming (NLP) optimisation solved independently at each charging point.Results based on real Iberian electricity market data show that battery degradation cost can exceed electricity cost by up to a factor of four, fundamentally altering optimal charging strategies. The proposed method achieves a total cost reduction of 33.78% compared to Plug & Charge and delivers seasonal savings of 40–60% over Plug & Charge and 6–25% over the best-performing conventional strategy (ALAP).The findings demonstrate that degradation-aware optimisation significantly modifies charging behaviour and is essential for cost-effective and lifetime-preserving EV operation in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑电池退化的电动汽车分散式充电优化框架，通过联合最小化购电成本和电池老化成本，在实际市场数据下实现了33.78%的总成本降低，并发现电池退化成本可高达电费的四倍。
AI.research_question: 如何将电池退化成本显式纳入电动汽车充电策略优化中，以实现购电成本与电池老化成本的最小化？
AI.motivation: 电池退化被视为电动汽车充电中的主导成本因素，但现有优化策略往往忽略或过度简化了这一因素，导致充电策略并非实际最优。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半经验老化模型（考虑日历老化与循环老化）、非线性规划（NLP）优化、退化货币化（基于真实电池市场数据）。
AI.method: 针对NMC锂电池实施半经验老化模型，捕捉温度、荷电状态（SoC）和循环条件的影响；将退化成本货币化后纳入NLP优化，在每个充电点独立求解；使用伊比利亚电力市场真实数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 电池退化成本可超过购电成本多达四倍；所提方法相比即插即充（Plug & Charge）实现33.78%的总成本降低；相比即插即充和最佳传统策略（ALAP）分别实现40–60%和6–25%的季节性节省。
AI.theory_contributions: 将日历老化与循环老化同时纳入充电优化，建立了更全面的电池退化成本模型；通过真实市场数据货币化退化成本，为充电策略的经济性分析提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车充电运营商和用户提供了可实际部署的退化感知充电策略，显著降低总拥有成本；证明了忽视退化成本将导致次优甚至适得其反的充电决策。

title: A bi-level scheduling model of battery swapping station cluster operator considering user's multi-utility under spatiotemporal aggregation
affiliations: North China Electric Power University, North China Electric Power University, University of Science and Technology Beijing, North China Electric Power University and North China Electric Power University

detail.title: A bi-level scheduling model of battery swapping station cluster operator considering user's multi-utility under spatiotemporal aggregation
detail.abstract: The battery swapping station cluster operator is a critical distributed flexible resource in the new-type power system. Enhancing synergy between swapping stations and renewable energy (RE) through spatiotemporal aggregation and user response is crucial for improving system flexibility and RE consumption. To this end, this study proposes a bi-level scheduling model for a battery swapping station cluster operator considering users’ multi-utility under spatiotemporal aggregation. Firstly, a closed-loop optimization framework integrating spatiotemporal prediction, dynamic decision-making, and user response is constructed, incorporating user behavior clustering and a road network distance decay model to achieve fine-grained station-level demand forecasting. Secondly, a bi-level Stackelberg game scheduling model is established: the upper-level objectives maximize net-load-to-RE matching and operator profit, while the lower-level objective maximizes user satisfaction, with a dynamic pricing mechanism and robust optimization addressing uncertainties. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through a case study. The results show that it reduces prediction errors by 32%, achieves an RE matching RMSE of 0.406, an average daily profit of 158,000 CNY, and user satisfaction of 85%, while demonstrating strong robustness under extreme scenarios. This research provides a systematic solution for battery swap station clusters to balance environmental performance, economic efficiency, and user experience during operator dispatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种考虑用户多效用与时空聚合的换电站集群双层调度模型，通过闭环优化框架、Stackelberg博弈和动态定价机制，实现换电站与可再生能源的高效协同，在降低预测误差的同时兼顾环境效益、经济效益和用户满意度。
AI.research_question: 如何通过时空聚合与用户响应提升换电站集群与可再生能源之间的协同效率，以增强系统灵活性和可再生能源消纳能力？
AI.motivation: 换电站集群作为新型电力系统中的关键分布式柔性资源，其与可再生能源的协同对提升系统灵活性和可再生能源消纳至关重要，但现有方法在时空聚合精度和用户响应建模方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stackelberg博弈理论；时空聚合理论；用户行为聚类；道路网络距离衰减模型；鲁棒优化
AI.method: 构建了时空预测-动态决策-用户响应的闭环优化框架，采用用户行为聚类与道路网络距离衰减模型实现精细化站级需求预测，并建立上下层Stackelberg博弈调度模型（上层最大化净负荷与可再生能源匹配度及运营商利润，下层最大化用户满意度），引入动态定价机制和鲁棒优化应对不确定性。
AI.findings: 预测误差降低32%，可再生能源匹配RMSE为0.406，日均利润15.8万元，用户满意度达85%，且在极端场景下展现出较强的鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Stackelberg博弈与时空聚合理论相结合，构建了考虑用户多效用的双层调度框架，为换电站集群参与电力系统灵活性调节提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为换电站运营商提供了兼顾环境绩效、经济效益和用户体验的系统性调度方案，具有较强的实际应用价值。

title: Short-Term Probabilistic Forecasting of Parking Occupancy Rates Using a Quantile TCN–LSTM Network
affiliations: Kunming University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Kunming University of Science and Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Short-Term Probabilistic Forecasting of Parking Occupancy Rates Using a Quantile TCN–LSTM Network
detail.abstract: Accurate parking occupancy forecasting plays a vital role in addressing parking shortages and relieving traffic congestion. The QR-TCN-LSTM framework proposed here integrates quantile regression into a hybrid TCN–LSTM architecture, enabling explicit uncertainty quantification alongside adaptive feature selection. Experiments spanning six parking facility types and two forecasting horizons (15 min and 60 min) cover point, interval, and probabilistic forecasting. At the 15-min horizon, the model achieves an MAE of 0.007163 and a MAPE of 1.3447%, with stable performance retained at 60 min. For interval forecasting, average CWC values of 0.4429 (15 min) and 1.3838 (60 min) are obtained, representing a maximum reduction of 59.01% over baseline models. The results demonstrate that quantile regression, when embedded in a TCN–LSTM architecture, yields prediction intervals that are both compact and well-calibrated, offering a reliable solution for parking occupancy forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了QR-TCN-LSTM框架，将分位数回归与TCN-LSTM混合架构相结合，用于停车场占用率预测，在点预测、区间预测和概率预测三个维度上均表现出色，尤其在15分钟和60分钟两个预测时域上取得了较低的误差和良好的区间校准效果。
AI.research_question: 如何实现高精度且具有不确定性量化能力的停车场占用率预测？
AI.motivation: 停车场短缺和交通拥堵问题日益严重，准确的停车占用率预测对于缓解这些问题至关重要，而现有方法在不确定性量化方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数回归（Quantile Regression）、时间卷积网络（TCN）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）以及混合深度学习架构。
AI.method: 将分位数回归嵌入TCN-LSTM混合架构中，实现显式的不确定性量化与自适应特征选择；在六种停车场设施类型和两个预测时域（15分钟和60分钟）上进行点预测、区间预测和概率预测实验。
AI.findings: 15分钟时域上MAE为0.007163，MAPE为1.3447%；60分钟时域上性能稳定。区间预测方面，平均CWC值分别为0.4429（15分钟）和1.3838（60分钟），相比基线模型最大降低59.01%。分位数回归嵌入TCN-LSTM架构能够生成既紧凑又校准良好的预测区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将分位数回归与TCN-LSTM混合架构系统性地结合用于停车场占用率预测，证明了该架构在不确定性量化方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为停车场管理和交通拥堵缓解提供了可靠的高精度预测工具，支持点预测、区间预测和概率预测三种输出形式，具有实际应用价值。

title: The structure of infrastructure adoption: competition of hydrogen and electric for long-haul freight decarbonization
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Georgia Institute of Technology - The H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial & Systems Engineering (ISyE) and Georgia Institute of Technology

detail.title: The structure of infrastructure adoption: competition of hydrogen and electric for long-haul freight decarbonization
detail.abstract: Long-haul freight decarbonization requires deploying new energy infrastructure—hydrogen refueling stations (HRS), electric charging, or emerging alternatives—across networks designed around incumbent diesel supply. Existing planning tools answer where to place stations but typically treat node-level refueling demand as a uniform or exogenously specified input, ignoring how it emerges from the coupling between freight flows and technology adoption dynamics. This paper develops a network-coupled deployment framework that integrates Bass diffusion adoption with a reinforcement-learning agent sequencing HRS installation under capital constraints. Applied to an empirical long-haul freight network derived from U.S. Freight Analysis Framework data (southeastern U.S. corridors) over a 50-year horizon, with systematic variation of carbon pricing, hydrogen cost trajectory, and deployment pace, the framework yields three quantitative findings. First, deployment pace provides a non-linear benefit: in the studied SE-US network, the adoption midpoint follows an empirical reciprocal relation t₀(k) ≈ 14.3/k + 15 (R² = 0.999), so that installing two or more stations per year activates the network and drives widespread adoption within roughly two decades, while installing more than four per year provides little additional benefit. Second, network position drives order-of-magnitude differences in node-level refueling demand—a high-centrality hub such as Atlanta exceeds 6.5 × 10⁸ kg/year at saturation under accelerated deployment while peripheral hubs generate roughly ten times less—challenging uniform station sizing assumptions. Third, the long-run fuel-cell electric truck (FCET) versus battery electric truck (BET) market split reduces to a linear function of the network's range advantage, ≈ 0.22 + 0.74ρ (R² = 1.00), where ρ is the fraction of tonne-hour capacity on corridors exceeding the BET range; this saturation relation is largely insensitive to fuel-cost dynamics once hydrogen reaches diesel parity. Together, these findings show that the long-run competition between hydrogen and battery-electric trucks is structured by two underlying mechanisms—deployment-pace activation and network-position-driven demand heterogeneity—yielding transferable scaling relationships for capital-constrained infrastructure planning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个网络耦合部署框架，整合Bass扩散模型与强化学习，研究美国东南部长途货运网络中氢燃料补给站（HRS）的部署策略。研究发现：部署速度具有非线性效益，年建2-4座站即可在20年内激活网络；节点需求差异可达数量级（亚特兰大等高中心性枢纽饱和需求超6.5×10⁸ kg/年，是边缘枢纽的10倍）；燃料电池卡车与电动卡车的长期市场分割线性取决于网络续航优势比ρ（FCET份额≈0.22+0.74ρ）。这些结果为资本约束下的基础设施规划提供了可迁移的标度关系。
AI.research_question: 在长途货运脱碳过程中，如何优化氢燃料补给站（及其他新能源基础设施）的时序部署策略？节点级加注需求如何从货运流与技术采纳动态的耦合中涌现？燃料电池卡车与电动卡车的长期市场分割由什么因素决定？
AI.motivation: 现有规划工具只回答"在哪里建站"，但将节点级需求视为同质化或外生给定输入，忽略了需求如何从货运流与技术采纳的耦合中内生涌现。需要整合需求涌现机制与部署时序优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bass扩散模型（技术采纳动力学）、强化学习（时序部署智能体）、网络分析（中心性与位置效应）、线性标度关系（市场分割对网络属性的依赖）。
AI.method: 构建网络耦合部署框架：用Bass扩散模型模拟FCET技术采纳，用强化学习代理在资本约束下序列化选择HRS安装节点。基于美国货运分析框架（FAF）数据提取东南部走廊实证网络，在50年时间跨度内系统变化碳定价、氢成本轨迹和部署速度参数。
AI.findings: (1) 部署速度具有非线性效益：采纳中点t₀(k)≈14.3/k+15 (R²=0.999)，年建2站以上可在约20年内激活网络，年建4站以上收益递减；(2) 节点需求差异达数量级：高中心性枢纽（如亚特兰大）饱和需求超6.5×10⁸ kg/年，是外围枢纽的近10倍；(3) FCET与BET长期市场分割为网络续航优势比ρ的线性函数：≈0.22+0.74ρ (R²=1.00)，一旦氢价达到柴油平价，该关系对燃料成本动态基本不敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了部署速度激活效应与网络位置驱动需求异质性两大底层机制，将技术扩散理论、网络分析与基础设施规划整合为可量化的标度关系，为资本约束下的时序部署提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和基础设施投资者提供可迁移的规划指导：(1) 年建2-4站是最优部署节奏；(2) 站点选址必须优先高中心性枢纽而非平均布点；(3) 氢能与电动卡车的竞争最终取决于网络拓扑对续航里程的约束，而非短期的燃料成本波动。

title: Optimization-based operation of a hydrogen refuelling station: lexicographic hybrid predictive control with multi-arrival readiness and opportunistic priority-level skipping
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Optimization-based operation of a hydrogen refuelling station: lexicographic hybrid predictive control with multi-arrival readiness and opportunistic priority-level skipping
detail.abstract: The operation of a Hydrogen Refuelling Station (HRS) imposes two structural challenges on optimization-based control. First, the operator pursues incommensurable competing objectives (refuelling availability, energy eﬃciency, economic benefit) ranked by a policy-imposed hierarchy; a weighted scalar cost requires extensive tuning to prevent economic objectives from dominating operational readiness or vice versa. Second, HRS dynamics combine continuous mass-and-pressure evolution with discrete, event-triggered behaviours governed by logic-based rules that purely continuous formulations cannot capture accurately. This paper proposes a Lexicographic Hybrid Model Predictive Control (L-HMPC) framework for an on-site renewable HRS serving Heavy-Duty Fuel-Cell V ehicles (HDFVs). The HRS is modelled using the Mixed Logical Dynamical formalism, which captures hydrogen flows, pressure dynamics, valve logic and event-triggered refuelling in a linear mixed-integer structure. An algebraic abstraction of a multi-arrival availability metric encodes the combinatorial dispensing logic. Two control layers are designed: a supervisory L-HMPC for non-refuelling mode with lexicographic priority ordering, and an event-triggered HMPC for refuelling mode. An Opportunistic Priority-Level Skipping (OPLS) procedure bypassing near-optimal priority levels mitigates the sequential pipeline’s computational burden. Validation in silico uses a real HRS with on-site electrolysis, photo- voltaic generation, battery storage and cascaded hydrogen storage, under scenario-based stochastic HDFV demand over five summer days. Across all configurations, nearly every refuelling event is fulfilled, lexicographic decisions remain interpretable, and net electricity exchange intensities of−25.9 to 0.1 kWh/kg indicate net export to the grid in most cases. OPLS reduces median per-call solving time by 39–49% and overall simulation time by 43%, without hindering operational or energy performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对加氢站（HRS）运行中多目标冲突与混杂动态两大控制难题，提出了一种词典式混合模型预测控制（L-HMPC）框架。该方法利用混合逻辑动态（MLD）建模氢气流动、压力动态与事件触发的加注逻辑，并设计两层级联控制与非占优优先级跳跃（OPLS）策略。仿真验证表明该方法能够高效满足加注需求、实现电网净输出，并显著降低求解时间。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种控制框架，以同时应对加氢站运行中（1）政策层级约束下的不可公度多目标优化（加注可用性、能效、经济效益）以及（2）连续质量-压力动态与离散事件触发行为耦合的混杂系统控制挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有基于加权标量成本的MPC方法在加氢站应用中难以调和政策层级约束下相互冲突的目标（如用能效率与经济收益的权衡），且纯连续模型无法准确刻画加氢站中阀门逻辑、事件触发加注等离散行为，亟需一种兼具优先级可解释性与混杂建模能力的控制框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 词典式优化（Lexicographic Optimization）；混合逻辑动态（MLD, Mixed Logical Dynamical）系统；模型预测控制（MPC）；事件触发控制（Event-triggered Control）；优先级跳跃（Priority-Level Skipping）策略。
AI.method: 首先采用MLD形式化方法对加氢站进行混杂系统建模，将氢气流、压力动态、阀门逻辑和事件触发加注行为编码为线性混合整数结构。然后设计双层控制架构：非加注模式下使用词典式HMPC（L-HMPC）按优先级逐层优化；加注模式下触发事件驱动HMPC。在此基础上提出OPLS策略跳过接近最优的优先级层级以降低计算负担。最后基于真实加氢站数据进行场景随机仿真验证（五天夏季、随机HDFV需求）。
AI.findings: （1）几乎所有加注事件均被满足；（2）词典式决策保持可解释性；（3）净电力交换强度为-25.9至0.1 kWh/kg，多数情况下实现向电网净输出；（4）OPLS使单次求解中位时间降低39–49%，总仿真时间降低43%，且未损害运行性能与能耗表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将词典式优化与MLD形式的混杂MPC结合应用于加氢站控制场景，为需求-政策双重约束下的混杂能源系统提供了可解释性优先级优化的理论框架；提出OPLS策略为词典式MPC的计算效率改进提供了通用思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加氢站运营者提供了一种可直接部署的控制方案，能够在满足政策层级优先约束（如优先保证加注可用性）的同时优化能效与经济性，并显著降低在线计算时间，提升实时可行性；仿真结果证明该方法可实现加氢站与电网的良性互动（净输出电力）。

title: Possible Contribution of Smart EV Charging and PV Curtailment to Mitigating Low Voltage Grid Congestions – a Simulation Study
affiliations: Vinnytsia National Technical University, University for Continuing Education Krems and University for Continuing Education Krems

detail.title: Possible Contribution of Smart EV Charging and PV Curtailment to Mitigating Low Voltage Grid Congestions – a Simulation Study

keywords.keywords: Smart GridDemand ResponseCongestion MitigationLoad ManagementPV CurtailmentEV Charging

detail.abstract: The charging of electric vehicles (EV) causes a significant demand for renewable energy. The EV charging is nicely control-able and should maximally use varying renewable sources: (a) to be charged from renewable sources and (b) to support the balancing need. Power flows, and hence electricity production, are determined by the demand. The demand needs to be adjusted to the availability of power to optimally use varying power sources,. The work presented uses the physical impact of loads on the local supply voltage to control EV charging, flexible loads, and PV production. The supply voltage communicates changes in real time and links the distributed smart control mechanisms into a swarm of cooperative autonomous systems. The event based simulation applies stochastic modelling and effective power flow analysis. The graphical results show that the daily peaks caused by PV generation and EV charging can be mitigated to the benefit of the supply voltage, the PV generation, and the EV charging. Numeric results show that for the evaluated scenario, PV curtailment can be mostly prevented, such that the PV output is raised by ∼120 kWh, and that smart EV charging sufficiently covers the daily demand ≤ 24 kWh. In conclusion, smart EV charging benefits local PV production, stabilises the supply voltage, and serves EV drivers well, if a sufficient number of EVs is available for smart EV charging to consume the local PV peak effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于本地供电电压实时通信的智能电动汽车充电控制方法，通过将分布式智能控制机制链接成协作自治系统，实现电动汽车充电、柔性负载和光伏发电的协调优化。仿真结果表明该方法能有效缓解光伏发电和电动汽车充电引起的日峰值问题，提升光伏产出并稳定供电电压。
AI.research_question: 如何利用本地供电电压作为实时通信信号，协调控制电动汽车充电、柔性负载和光伏发电，以最大化利用可再生能源并稳定电网电压？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车充电对可再生能源产生巨大需求，而电动汽车充电具有良好可控性，应充分利用可变的可再生能源。现有研究需要解决如何根据电力可用性调整需求，以最优利用变化电源的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于负载对本地供电电压的物理影响理论，利用供电电压实时通信机制，将分布式智能控制链接成协作自治系统（swarm of cooperative autonomous systems）。
AI.method: 采用基于事件的仿真方法，应用随机建模和有效潮流分析，通过供电电压实时传递变化信号，协调控制电动汽车充电、柔性负载和光伏发电。
AI.findings: 1) 光伏发电和电动汽车充电引起的日峰值可得到缓解，有利于供电电压稳定、光伏发电和电动汽车充电；2) 光伏削减大部分可被避免，光伏输出提升约120 kWh；3) 智能电动汽车充电可充分满足每日≤24 kWh的需求；4) 需要足够数量的电动汽车参与智能充电，以有效消耗本地光伏峰值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利用供电电压作为实时通信媒介的分布式智能控制框架，将物理电气信号与智能控制算法相结合，为多主体自治协作系统在电力需求侧管理中的应用提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种无需额外通信基础设施的低成本电压控制方法；2) 有效减少了光伏弃电，提升了光伏发电的经济效益；3) 稳定了供电电压，改善了电能质量；4) 满足了电动汽车用户的充电需求，促进了电动汽车与可再生能源的协同发展。

title: Long-Term Real-Life Evaluation of an Innovative Dew Point Evaporative Cooling for Edge Data Centre
affiliations: University of Hull, University of Hull, Kingston University, University of Hull, University of Hull and University of Hull

detail.title: Long-Term Real-Life Evaluation of an Innovative Dew Point Evaporative Cooling for Edge Data Centre
detail.abstract: Small-scale edge data centres and server rooms are expanding with digitalisation, AI deployment and distributed computing, but their cooling systems are often less efficient than those in large data centres. This paper presents, to the authors’ knowledge, the first full-year real-life monitoring study of an innovative dew-point evaporative cooling (DPC) system installed in a live edge data centre in the UK. The study moves DPC evaluation beyond laboratory testing and short-term prototype trials towards higher technology readiness under practical operating conditions. The system was assessed using performance mapping, full-year monitoring data, seasonal temperature profiles, hourly summer-event analysis and microbiological monitoring. During annual operation, the DPC system provided effective indoor temperature management, with monthly average COP values generally between 27 and 36 during normal operating periods. However, the COP reduced to approximately 18 during the constrained summer operation in July. The analysis shows that DPC performance depends not only on the heat and mass exchanger, but also on system-level factors such as installation arrangement, outdoor conditions, ductwork, airflow management and interaction with existing split units. Microbiological monitoring showed that no dip-slide sample exceeded the unacceptable threshold when a bespoke risk management protocol was applied. The results demonstrate that DPC can provide high-COP, low-electricity base cooling for small edge data centres. However, successful deployment requires appropriate system-level design, hybrid control with auxiliary split units, and low-burden water-side maintenance strategies. These findings provide first-hand long-term field evidence for the practical application of innovative DPC technology in edge data centre cooling.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了首个在英国实际运行的边缘数据中心中安装的创新露点蒸发冷却（DPC）系统的全年真实监测研究，发现该系统在全年运行中能提供高效基础冷却（COP通常在27-36之间），但受系统级设计、混合控制和水侧维护等因素影响，成功部署需要综合考虑安装布局、气流管理和辅助设备协同。
AI.research_question: 在真实的边缘数据中心运行条件下，创新露点蒸发冷却（DPC）系统能否实现高效、可靠的全年冷却性能？
AI.motivation: 随着数字化、AI部署和分布式计算的发展，小型边缘数据中心不断扩张，但其冷却系统效率通常低于大型数据中心，缺乏对新型DPC技术在真实长周期运行条件下的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 露点蒸发冷却技术原理、数据中心热管理理论、系统级冷却性能影响因素分析框架。
AI.method: 性能映射、全年监测数据采集、季节性温度剖面分析、夏季逐时事件分析以及微生物监测。
AI.findings: DPC系统在全年运行中有效管理室内温度，月度平均COP在正常运行期间为27-36，夏季受限运行期间降至约18；DPC性能取决于系统级因素（安装布局、室外条件、风管设计、气流管理及与现有分体式机组的交互）；在应用定制风险管理协议下微生物样本未超标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DPC评估从实验室测试和短期原型试验推进到高技术成熟度的实际运行条件，提供了首个全年真实运行监测证据，揭示了系统级因素对DPC性能的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为边缘数据中心的实用冷却方案提供了实证依据，指出成功部署需要适当的系统级设计、与辅助分体式机组的混合控制策略以及低负担的水侧维护策略。

title: Market-Informed Feature Engineering for Day-Ahead Price Forecasting in ERCOT
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Market-Informed Feature Engineering for Day-Ahead Price Forecasting in ERCOT
detail.abstract: The Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) operates an energy-only wholesale electricitymarket characterized by high renewable penetration, limited inter-grid connectivity, and scarcity-driven real-time pricing. These structural features produce pronounced price-spike dynamics thatmake day-ahead price forecasting both more di!cult and more consequential for market participants.Existing electricity price forecasting research relies predominantly on standardized feature sets,typically lagged prices and load forecasts, that often fail to explicitly encode grid-stress and scarcityconditions that drive spikes, and spike forecasting accuracy remains a challenge. This study addressesboth gaps through the development of a day-ahead forecasting model for the ERCOT North Load Zonewhich combines a market-informed feature set that captures underlying price-formation mechanismsand forecasts price spikes via a regime-switching random forest ensemble method (MoE-RF). Allinput data is restricted to information available to market participants before the 10h00 gate closure— the submission deadline for day-ahead market bids. Predictive accuracy is evaluated on a full out-of-sample year, 2024, and the MoE-RF model significantly outperforms SARIMAX, LEAR, and naivebenchmark models. Furthermore, this study tests whether data published after gate closure enhancespredictive accuracy and finds no measurable gain. This indicates that the feature set developed in thisstudy captures the dynamics relevant to price formation, underscoring the value in applying domainknowledge to feature engineering. It further demonstrates that respecting the gate closure deadlinecan be adopted as an explicit design requirement without sacrificing predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文为ERCOT北负荷区开发了一种结合市场信息特征集与机制切换随机森林（MoE-RF）的日前电价预测模型，该模型在2024年全样本外测试中显著优于SARIMAX、LEAR等基准模型，并证明了截止时间前可用数据已足以实现高精度预测。
AI.research_question: 如何通过市场信息特征集和机制切换随机森林方法，提升高可再生能源渗透率、稀缺定价驱动的电力市场（ERCOT）的日前电价峰值预测精度？
AI.motivation: 现有电价预测研究依赖标准化特征集（滞后价格、负荷预测），未能显式编码电网压力和稀缺条件，导致峰值预测准确性不足；同时市场参与者面临报价截点（gate closure）的信息约束，现有研究对此关注有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电价形成机制理论（稀缺定价、市场力）、机制切换模型（regime-switching）、随机森林集成方法（Mixture of Experts, MoE）。
AI.method: 构建包含市场信息（如备用容量、边际机组类型等）的特征集，采用MoE-RF（机制切换随机森林集成）模型进行日前电价峰值预测，以SARIMAX、LEAR和朴素模型为基准，在2024年全样本外数据上评估。
AI.findings: MoE-RF模型显著优于所有基准模型；截点后发布的数据不能提升预测精度，说明所构建的特征集已充分捕捉电价形成动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场微观结构（稀缺定价机制）显式纳入特征工程，验证了领域知识驱动的特征集比标准化特征集更有效；证明了报价截点作为预测模型设计约束的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ERCOT市场参与者提供了高精度的日前电价预测工具；证明了遵守市场报价截点不会牺牲预测性能，具有直接的操作指导意义。

title: Potential of Optimal Multi-Objective Demand Side Management in Integrated District Heating and Cooling Networks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Geneva and Swiss Federal Laboratories for Material Science and Technology (EMPA)

detail.title: Potential of Optimal Multi-Objective Demand Side Management in Integrated District Heating and Cooling Networks

keywords: Integrated district heating and cooling networks

detail.abstract: The optimal operation of integrated district heating and cooling (DHC) networks requires flexibility to lower costs, reduce emissions, and mitigate peak loads. While these systems are often subject to inflexible, rule-based control (RBC) thermal demands, demand-side management (DSM) can leverage the thermal inertia of buildings as a zero-capital-cost source of flexibility. To study the potential benefits achievable through DSM, this study first translates detailed white-box building simulations into low-complexity, calibrated grey-box resistance-capacitance (RC) models to accurately represent a real DHC network in Zürich, Switzerland. Then, using a multi-objective optimization framework, we compare standard RBC against DSM. Results demonstrate that optimally coordinating building thermal demands achieves substantial benefits, including a 6.2% reduction in operational costs, a 91.1% reduction in carbon emissions, and peak load shaving of 24.5% for heating and 53.8% for cooling. Optimizing for individual benefits, however, imposes severe penalties across other metrics. Multi-dimensional Pareto surfaces highlight this inherent conflict and visualize the system's optimal operation space. Furthermore, sensitivity analyses reveal that dynamic hourly tariffs and relaxed lower-bound indoor temperatures are critical to increase DSM cost-saving potential. Moreover, the results indicate that under DSM, the distributed storage in the thermal mass of the buildings connected to the studied network are equivalent to an 800–900 kWh centralized thermal energy storage (TES) unit, representing 15 times the currently installed capacity, offering the potential to offset physical infrastructure investments in modern integrated DHC systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过灰盒RC模型模拟苏黎世某区域供热供冷网络，发现需求侧管理（DSM）可显著降低运营成本（6.2%）、碳排放（91.1%）并削减峰值负荷（供热24.5%，供冷53.8%），相当于替代800–900 kWh的集中式储能装置，但多目标间存在明显权衡。
AI.research_question: 需求侧管理（DSM）如何利用建筑热惯性为区域供热供冷网络提供灵活性，以及在多目标优化下能实现多大的成本、排放和峰值负荷效益？
AI.motivation: 传统区域供热供冷网络依赖刚性规则控制，缺乏灵活性；而建筑热惯性作为一种零资本成本的灵活性资源尚未被充分挖掘。本研究旨在量化DSM的实际潜力，并揭示多目标之间的冲突关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灰盒电阻-电容（RC）模型（从白盒模拟降阶校准）；多目标优化框架；帕累托前沿分析；敏感性分析。
AI.method: 将详细的白盒建筑模拟转化为低复杂度的校准灰盒RC模型，代表苏黎世真实的DHC网络；采用多目标优化框架对比标准规则控制（RBC）与需求侧管理（DSM）。
AI.findings: 1) DSM带来6.2%运营成本降低、91.1%碳排放减少、供热峰值负荷削减24.5%、供冷峰值负荷削减53.8%；2) 单目标优化会在其他指标上造成严重惩罚；3) 动态小时电价和放松室内温度下限是提升成本节约潜力的关键；4) DSM相当于800–900 kWh的集中式储热能力（现有容量的15倍）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将灰盒RC模型与多目标优化相结合，系统量化了DSM在真实DHC网络中的多重效益及目标间的权衡关系，并建立了分布式热惯性与集中式储能的等效性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DHC系统运营商提供DSM部署的量化依据；证明建筑热惯性可替代大规模集中式储能投资；揭示动态定价和温度设定值调整对成本效益的关键影响，指导实际运行策略设计。

title: Integrating Photovoltaic-Thermal Systems, Multi-Energy Storage and Demand Response for Cost-Effective Sustainable Manufacturing Systems
affiliations: University of Illinois Chicago, University of Illinois Chicago and University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: Integrating Photovoltaic-Thermal Systems, Multi-Energy Storage and Demand Response for Cost-Effective Sustainable Manufacturing Systems
detail.abstract: The manufacturing sector is a major contributor to global energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions, highlighting the need for effective strategies to integrate on-site renewable energy and reduce fossil fuel dependence in industrial systems.
