affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics and University of Waterloo

detail.title: An Efficient Multimodal Transformer with Large Language Model-Inspired Components for Lithium-Ion Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction under Limited Charging Cycles
detail.abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction for lithium-ion batteries is commonly developed using long-horizon lifecycle data, whereas practical applications often provide only a few charging records, making degradation learning and model generalization highly challenging. To address this extreme low-data scenario, this study proposes an efficient multimodal Transformer framework with large language model (LLM)-inspired components for battery RUL prediction under limited charging cycles. The proposed framework jointly exploits 1D charging curves and their corresponding gramian angular field (GAF) image representations. Only five consecutive charging cycles are used as input, accounting for approximately 0.6% of the entire battery lifetime, where the 1D signals include voltage, current, temperature, and capacity. A dual-branch encoder is designed to extract modality-specific representations, with a 1D-CNN capturing local temporal patterns from charging curves and a 2D-CNN learning spatial features from GAF images. The resulting tokens are concatenated and fed into a stacked Transformer to model cross-modal interactions for RUL regression. To improve computational practicality for long-token multimodal fusion, the framework incorporates several LLM-inspired components, including FlashAttention for memory-efficient attention computation, rotary positional embedding for relative positional modeling, and a mixture-of-experts module for conditional capacity scaling. Experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently achieves superior performance under the extremely limited-data regime, highlighting its strong accuracy, robustness, and cross-dataset generalization capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效多模态Transformer框架，利用大语言模型启发的组件，仅需5个充电周期（约电池全寿命的0.6%）即可准确预测锂离子电池的剩余使用寿命（RUL），在极低数据场景下表现出优异的精度和泛化能力。
AI.research_question: 在仅有极少充电记录（极端低数据场景）下，如何有效预测锂离子电池的剩余使用寿命？
AI.motivation: 实际应用中往往只能获取少量充电记录，而现有RUL预测方法通常依赖长周期全寿命数据，这导致退化学习困难且模型泛化能力差。因此，亟需一种能够在极端低数据场景下高效预测电池RUL的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态Transformer框架；格拉姆角场（GAF）图像表示；FlashAttention；旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）；混合专家模型（MoE）；1D-CNN与2D-CNN双分支编码器。
AI.method: 提出一种高效多模态Transformer框架：1）同时利用1D充电曲线（电压、电流、温度、容量）及其对应的格拉姆角场（GAF）图像表征；2）设计双分支编码器，1D-CNN提取局部时序特征，2D-CNN提取GAF图像空间特征；3）将生成的token拼接后输入堆叠Transformer进行跨模态交互和RUL回归；4）集成FlashAttention、旋转位置嵌入和混合专家模块提升计算效率。
AI.findings: 在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在极端有限数据条件下（仅5个充电周期，约0.6%寿命数据）持续实现优越性能，表现出强准确性、鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将大语言模型中的先进组件（FlashAttention、RoPE、MoE）引入电池RUL预测任务；2. 提出在极端低数据场景下联合利用1D时序信号和2D GAF图像的多模态框架；3. 验证了跨模态交互对有限数据下退化学习的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 仅需5个充电周期即可实现高精度RUL预测，大幅降低数据采集成本和时间；2. 模型具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力，适用于不同电池类型和使用场景；3. 计算效率高，具备实际部署的可行性。

title: Study on optimization strategy for cold start of PEMFC based on CGA-Net and HOA
affiliations: Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Wenzhou University

detail.title: Study on optimization strategy for cold start of PEMFC based on CGA-Net and HOA
detail.abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) are regarded as a promising energy conversion technology because of their clean operation, low acoustic emission, and environmental compatibility. Nevertheless, subzero startup remains a major obstacle to the practical application of PEMFCs, because the coupled transport, phase-change, and electrochemical processes inside the cell are highly intricate and cannot be described accurately with simple analytical approaches. To address this issue, a three-dimensional multiphase non-isothermal numerical model was established for PEMFC cold start. Based on this model, a first-order finite-difference sensitivity analysis was performed to identify six dominant control parameters: namely, the initial membrane water content (), initial current density (), gas diffusion layer porosity (), catalyst layer porosity (), ionomer volume fraction (), and membrane thickness (). A convolutional neural network–gated recurrent unit–attention architecture (CGA-Net) was constructed as the surrogate model and further integrated with the Hippopotamus Optimization Algorithm (HOA) to jointly optimize these parameters. The optimization was carried out with two objectives: improving the uniformity of ice distribution in the cathode catalyst layer (CCL) and prolonging the cold-start failure time. Under the optimized parameter combination, the ice distribution uniformity index reached 0.153809, representing a 3.609% improvement over the baseline case. Meanwhile, the cold-start failure time increased to 265.35s, which is 8.746% longer than the baseline value. These findings demonstrate that the proposed method mitigates performance deterioration caused by localized ice accumulation, thereby contributing to improved fuel cell durability. The prolonged failure time further implies that ice formation is suppressed during cold start, which may facilitate faster startup in subsequent auxiliary-heating-assisted cold-start processes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）低温启动难题，构建了三维多相非等温数值模型，通过灵敏度分析识别出六个关键控制参数，并利用CGA-Net代理模型结合河马优化算法（HOA）进行多目标优化，显著提升了冰分布均匀性和冷启动失败时间。
AI.research_question: 如何通过参数优化改善PEMFC冷启动过程中的冰分布均匀性并延长冷启动失败时间？
AI.motivation: PEMFC在零下温度启动时，耦合的传质、相变和电化学过程极为复杂，传统解析方法难以准确描述，导致低温启动成为实际应用的主要障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三维多相非等温数值模型、一阶有限差分灵敏度分析、CGA-Net（CNN-GRU-Attention）代理模型、河马优化算法（HOA）。
AI.method: 建立三维多相非等温数值模型 → 一阶有限差分灵敏度分析识别六个主导参数 → 构建CGA-Net代理模型 → 结合HOA进行多目标优化。
AI.findings: 优化后冰分布均匀性指数达0.153809（提升3.609%），冷启动失败时间延长至265.35秒（提升8.746%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将CGA-Net深度学习代理模型与HOA智能优化算法相结合，系统性地解决了PEMFC冷启动的多参数耦合优化问题，为复杂多物理场系统的参数优化提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 优化后的参数组合可缓解局部积冰导致的性能衰减，提升燃料电池耐久性；延长的失败时间表明结冰受到抑制，有助于后续辅助加热冷启动中实现更快启动。

title: Probabilistic Carbon Risk Forecasting for Emerging Emission Trading Markets: A Bayesian Transfer Transformer Approach under Data Scarcity
affiliations: Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou University and Nanjing University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Probabilistic Carbon Risk Forecasting for Emerging Emission Trading Markets: A Bayesian Transfer Transformer Approach under Data Scarcity
detail.abstract: Accurate carbon market risk forecasting is essential for emission trading systems, energy sector compliance planning, carbon cost management, and low carbon investment decisions. However, emerging regional carbon markets are often characterized by short trading histories, limited liquidity, heterogeneous market structures, and policy driven volatility, which weaken the reliability of conven tional forecasting models under conditions of data scarcity. This study proposes a Bayesian Transfer Transformer framework for probabilistic carbon market risk forecasting in emerging emission trading markets. The proposed framework uses information learned from a relatively mature source carbon market to construct probabilistic prior constraints for a target market with limited data. Instead of directly transferring fixed parameters or point estimates, posterior information from the source market is incorporated into target market learning through a Bayesian transfer mechanism, allowing the model to exploit regularities across markets while retaining risk dynamics specific to the target market. A Transformer based temporal representation module is used to capture nonlinear risk evolution, while stochastic posterior inference generates both point forecasts and prediction intervals for risk assessment under uncertainty. The framework is empirically evaluated using China’s regional carbon markets, with the Hubei ETS serving as the source market and the Fujian ETS, which has limited data, serving as the target market. Carbon market risk is measured by a forward looking volatility indicator, and the input feature set includes price risk indicators, technical signals, liquidity measures, energy price variables, and compliance cycle information. The proposed model is compared with econometric, machine learning, deep learning, Transformer trained only on the target market, and fine tuned Transformer benchmarks. Empirical results show that the Bayesian Transfer Transformer substantially improves point forecasting accuracy and interval forecasting performance, particularly when training samples from the target market are limited. The 95% prediction intervals achieve high empirical coverage, indicating that the proposed framework provides useful uncertainty information for carbon risk monitoring. Robustness and ablation analyses further confirm the contributions of market transfer, Bayesian posterior constraints, and uncertainty estimation. These findings suggest that Bayesian transfer learning provides a practical and computationally tractable tool for carbon risk forecasting in emerging carbon markets, with implications for allowance procurement, regulatory monitoring, and carbon asset risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯迁移Transformer框架，利用成熟碳市场信息帮助数据稀缺的新兴碳市场进行风险预测，在中国区域碳市场验证显示其显著提升了点预测和区间预测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据稀缺的新兴碳市场中实现准确的风险预测？
AI.motivation: 新兴区域碳市场交易历史短、流动性有限、市场结构异质且受政策驱动波动大，传统预测模型在数据稀缺条件下可靠性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯迁移学习、Transformer时序表征、随机后验推断
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯迁移Transformer框架：源碳市场（湖北）的后验信息通过贝叶斯机制融入目标市场（福建）学习，Transformer捕捉非线性风险演化，随机后验推断生成点预测和预测区间。
AI.findings: 贝叶斯迁移Transformer在目标市场训练样本有限时，点预测精度和区间预测性能显著优于计量模型、机器学习、深度学习及仅用目标市场训练的Transformer；95%预测区间达到高经验覆盖率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将贝叶斯迁移学习引入碳市场风险预测领域，提出通过后验信息而非固定参数迁移实现跨市场知识共享，在保留目标市场特有风险动态的同时利用市场间规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据稀缺的新兴碳市场提供实用的碳风险预测工具，对配额采购、监管监测和碳资产管理具有实践意义。

title: Interaction Path Analysis and Privileged Learning Based Oscillation Risk Assessment for Multiple Wind Farms With MMC-HVDC System
affiliations: Sichuan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sichuan University, Sichuan University and Sichuan University

detail.title: Interaction Path Analysis and Privileged Learning Based Oscillation Risk Assessment for Multiple Wind Farms With MMC-HVDC System
detail.abstract: In wind farm (WF) transmission via modular multilevel converter-based high-voltage DC (MMC-HVDC) systems, the dominant oscillatory modes jointly established by multiple WFs and the MMC-HVDC may give rise to subsynchronous oscillations. Although the underlying mechanisms of such oscillations have been identified in prior studies, the complex interaction paths among WFs and the MMC-HVDC, as well as their impact on stability remain insufficiently elucidated. To bridge this gap, this paper develops an extended interaction path analysis method that explicitly characterizes the interaction paths between MMC-HVDC and each WF. On this basis, the mechanism through which these interactions drive unstable oscillation modes is theoretically analyzed. Furthermore, a quantitative interaction index is introduced to evaluate the interaction strength within critical frequency bands, thereby assessing the contribution of each WF to the oscillation instability risk. Moreover, a privileged-information-enhanced time-frequency network (PIETFNet) is proposed to predict the interaction index, serving as a monitoring tool for assessing vulnerable WFs during system operation. In PIETFNet, privileged frequency-domain information is distilled during training to enhance teacher network representation learning, enabling the student network to capture complex interaction dynamics using only time-domain inputs during deployment. Case studies verify the theoretical analysis of the interaction mechanism, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed interaction index, and show that the student network achieves prediction accuracy close to that of the multimodal teacher while requiring only time-domain inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MMC-HVDC系统中风电场与换流器之间的次同步振荡问题，提出了一种扩展交互路径分析方法，揭示了多风电场与MMC-HVDC的交互机理及稳定性影响，并开发了基于特权信息增强的时间-频率网络（PIETFNet）用于在线监测脆弱风电场。
AI.research_question: 在基于MMC-HVDC的风电场送出系统中，多风电场与MMC-HVDC之间的复杂交互路径如何影响系统稳定性？如何量化并在线监测各风电场的振荡失稳风险？
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽已识别了次同步振荡的潜在机理，但多风电场与MMC-HVDC之间的复杂交互路径及其对稳定性的影响尚未得到充分阐明，缺乏有效的量化评估和在线监测手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展交互路径分析方法、定量交互指标、特权信息增强的时间-频率网络（PIETFNet）、知识蒸馏（教师-学生网络架构）
AI.method: 首先提出扩展交互路径分析方法，刻画MMC-HVDC与各风电场的交互路径；通过理论分析揭示交互驱动不稳定振荡的机理；定义定量交互指标评估关键频段内的交互强度；提出PIETFNet，在训练时利用频域特权信息增强教师网络表征学习，使学生网络在部署时仅需时域输入即可预测交互指标。
AI.findings: 案例验证了交互机理的理论分析；所提交互指标能有效评估各风电场对振荡失稳风险的贡献；学生网络在仅需时域输入的情况下，预测精度接近多模态教师网络。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了扩展交互路径分析方法，从理论上揭示了多风电场与MMC-HVDC之间交互驱动不稳定振荡的机理；提出了量化交互指标，为评估各风电场对振荡失稳的贡献提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出的PIETFNet可在运行时仅用时域数据预测交互指标，实现对脆弱风电场的在线监测，为系统运维人员提供预警和决策支持。

title: A Lightweight Reservoir Computing Approach with Multi-Scale Attention for Robust Speaker Verification
affiliations: Universidade Federal Fluminense and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Lightweight Reservoir Computing Approach with Multi-Scale Attention for Robust Speaker Verification
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a lightweight architecture for speaker recognition and verification that integrates Reservoir Computing (RC) with multi-scale and multi-head attention mechanisms. The fixed recurrent reservoir captures long-term temporal dynamics, while attention modules selectively aggregate speaker-discriminative information across multiple temporal resolutions. By restricting learning to compact projection and attention layers, the proposed RC-Attention framework significantly reduces the number of trainable parameters while preserving strong discriminative capability. The system is evaluated on three widely used benchmarks, VoxCeleb1, LibriSpeech, and CNCeleb1, covering both in-domain and cross-corpus open-set verification scenarios. Results show that the proposed model achieves competitive Equal Error Rate (EER) performance compared to state-of-the-art deep architectures, despite operating with at least 3.5x fewer parameters. An ablation study further confirms that reservoir dimensionality and multi-scale temporal aggregation are the main contributors to performance, while attention mechanisms enhance robustness and feature integration. Cross-corpus evaluations reveal strong generalization under domain and language mismatch, with consistent improvements on LibriSpeech and CNCe\-leb1. These results indicate that combining fixed temporal dynamics with lightwei\-ght attention-based aggregation provides an efficient and robust framework for speaker representation learning, particularly suited to resource-constrained and real-time applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的说话人识别与验证架构，将储层计算（Reservoir Computing, RC）与多尺度、多头注意力机制相结合。通过固定循环储层捕获长期时间动态，注意力模块在多个时间分辨率上有选择性聚合说话人判别信息，训练参数量大幅减少（至少3.5倍），但在VoxCeleb1、LibriSpeech和CNCeleb1三个基准上取得了与深度架构相当的EER性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个参数量少、计算效率高且在说话人识别与验证任务中保持强判别能力的轻量级架构？
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的说话人识别模型参数量大、计算成本高，难以部署在资源受限和实时应用的场景中。因此，需要探索一种既轻量又具有强泛化能力和判别能力的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 储层计算（Reservoir Computing）处理长期时间动态；多尺度与多头注意力机制用于选择性聚合不同时间分辨率上的说话人判别特征；固定储层+轻量可训练注意力/投影层的混合架构。
AI.method: 提出RC-Attention框架：固定循环储层提取时序特征；多尺度多头注意力模块在不同时间粒度上聚合判别信息；仅训练紧凑的投影层和注意力层。在VoxCeleb1、LibriSpeech、CNCeleb1三个基准上进行域内和跨语料库开集验证，并与SOTA深度架构对比。
AI.findings: 1) 参数量至少减少3.5倍，但EER性能与SOTA深度架构相当；2) 储层维度和多尺度时间聚合是性能的主要贡献因素；3) 注意力机制增强了鲁棒性和特征整合；4) 跨语料库评估显示在域和语言不匹配下仍具强泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了固定时间动态（储层计算）与轻量注意力聚合相结合是一种有效且鲁棒的说话人表示学习范式，为降低说话人识别模型复杂度提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种适合资源受限和实时应用的轻量级说话人识别架构，参数量低但性能优越，且在跨域、跨语言场景下泛化能力强，具有实际部署价值。

title: A Preference-Driven NSGA-III Using Fuzzy AHP for Multiobjective Wind Farm Layout Optimization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, King Abdulaziz University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Preference-Driven NSGA-III Using Fuzzy AHP for Multiobjective Wind Farm Layout Optimization
detail.abstract: Wind farm layout optimization is a complex multiobjective problem that requires balancing conflicting technical and infrastructure-related objectives while enabling effective decision-making. Although the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III) can generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions, it does not explicitly incorporate decision-maker preferences, which often complicates the selection of practical compromise layouts. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a preference-driven optimization framework that integrates the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) into NSGA-III. The proposed NSGA-III+FAHP embeds structured preference information directly into the evolutionary search, guiding the population toward decision-relevant regions of the Pareto front. The approach is evaluated on a wind farm layout optimization problem that maximizes annual energy production and minimizes road length. Comparative results demonstrate that NSGA-III+FAHP consistently outperforms the conventional NSGA-III by producing superior trade-offs, a more structured and interpretable Pareto front, and improved decision quality without increasing computational cost, making it well-suited for practical wind energy planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将模糊层次分析法（FAHP）集成到NSGA-III中的偏好驱动优化框架，用于解决风电场布局优化这一多目标问题。实验表明，该方法在不增加计算成本的前提下，能够生成更优的权衡方案、更结构化的帕累托前沿，并提升决策质量。
AI.research_question: 如何将决策者偏好有效融入多目标风电场布局优化中，以提升解的可选择性和决策质量？
AI.motivation: 标准NSGA-III算法虽能生成多样化的帕累托最优解，但未明确纳入决策者偏好，导致实际中选择折中方案时存在困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非支配排序遗传算法III（NSGA-III）、模糊层次分析法（FAHP）、偏好驱动的多目标优化理论
AI.method: 将FAHP嵌入NSGA-III的进化搜索过程，将结构化的偏好信息直接引导种群向帕累托前沿中与决策相关的区域收敛。
AI.findings: NSGA-III+FAHP相比传统NSGA-III，在最大化年发电量和最小化道路长度两个目标上产生了更优的权衡解、更结构化和可解释的帕累托前沿，且未增加计算成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种偏好驱动的多目标进化优化新框架，证明了将偏好信息嵌入进化搜索可提升帕累托前沿的结构性和可解释性，为多目标算法与决策分析方法的融合提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风电场规划提供了一种高效、实用的布局优化工具，能够在不增加计算负担的情况下生成更符合决策者偏好的解决方案，有助于提升实际风电项目的决策质量。

title: Data-driven human factor analysis for oil pipeline accidents using LLM and Bayesian network
affiliations: Hebei Normal University, Hebei Normal University, Hebei Normal University and Hebei Normal University

detail.title: Data-driven human factor analysis for oil pipeline accidents using LLM and Bayesian network
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of oil pipeline networks has escalated safety concerns, yet current Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRAs) remain heavily reliant on subjective expert judgment, often failing to fully utilize complex, unstructured accident narratives. To address this gap, this study proposes a novel, data-driven analytical framework based on 5,636 oil pipeline incident reports from the U.S. PHMSA database (2010–2025). The methodology integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with the Human Factors Analysis and Classification System based on Chain-of-Thought(HFACS-CoT) strategy, employing a direct inference-to-matching approach to automatically extract and standardize 64 hierarchical causal factors. Subsequently, a Bayesian Network was constructed using statistical screening of high-frequency causal chains and maximum likelihood estimation to reveal probabilistic dependencies and risk transmission patterns across five accident types. Results demonstrate a distinct hierarchical transmission pattern characterized by upper-level dominance and lower-level triggering. Specifically, systemic management deficits in organizational influences—such as inadequate integrity management systems—and unsafe supervision were identified as pervasive, cross-type root causes. In contrast, specific preconditions (e.g., equipment aging) and unsafe acts (e.g., illegal excavation) function as type-dependent triggers. Crucially, the findings reveal that leakages are predominantly driven by chronic systemic degradations, whereas mechanical punctures are acutely triggered by external third-party violations under regulatory vacuums. By eliminating semantic ambiguity and algorithmic hallucinations through the HFACS-CoT alignment, and by eradicating subjective bias via data-driven parameterization, this framework provides an objective, scalable tool for proactive pipeline safety management.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于美国PHMSA数据库5,636份油气管道事故报告（2010-2025），提出了一种结合大语言模型（LLM）与基于思维链的人因分析与分类系统（HFACS-CoT）的数据驱动分析框架。通过自动提取64个层级因果因素、构建贝叶斯网络，揭示了五种事故类型中"上层主导、下层触发"的层级传递模式：组织影响的系统性管理缺陷和 unsafe supervision 是跨类型的根本原因，而特定前提条件（如设备老化）和 unsafe acts（如非法挖掘）则是类型依赖的直接触发因素。泄漏主要由慢性系统退化驱动，机械穿孔则由监管真空下的外部第三方违规急剧触发。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大规模事故文本数据（而非主观专家判断）构建客观、可量化的管道事故因果分析框架，以揭示不同类型事故的风险传递路径和根本原因？
AI.motivation: 现有定量风险评估（QRA）过度依赖主观专家判断，未能充分利用复杂、非结构化的事故叙事文本，导致分析存在语义模糊、主观偏差等问题，亟需一种数据驱动的客观分析方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 人因分析与分类系统（HFACS）；2. 基于思维链（Chain-of-Thought）的推理策略；3. 贝叶斯网络（Bayesian Network）；4. 最大似然估计（MLE）；5. 层级因果因素分类体系（64个层级因素）。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：美国PHMSA数据库5,636份管道事故报告（2010-2025）；2. 使用LLM + HFACS-CoT策略进行自动因果因素提取与标准化；3. 统计筛选高频因果链；4. 最大似然估计构建贝叶斯网络，揭示概率依赖关系和风险传递模式。
AI.findings: 1. 存在"上层主导、下层触发"的层级传递模式；2. 组织影响中的系统性管理缺陷（如完整性管理系统不足）和 unsafe supervision 是跨类型的普遍性根本原因；3. 特定前提条件（设备老化）和 unsafe acts（非法挖掘）是类型依赖的直接触发因素；4. 泄漏主要由慢性系统退化驱动，机械穿孔则由监管真空下的外部第三方违规触发。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了LLM与HFACS-CoT相结合的自动化因果因素提取方法，消除语义歧义和算法幻觉；2. 通过数据驱动参数化替代主观判断，消除主观偏差；3. 构建了跨事故类型的贝叶斯网络风险传递模型，揭示不同类型事故的差异化因果路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管道安全管理提供了客观、可扩展的分析工具；2. 有助于企业区分不同类型事故的预防重点（慢性系统退化 vs. 外部违规）；3. 支持主动式安全管理的决策制定。

title: Navigating Institutional Frictions: A Longitudinal Analysis of Cross-Sectoral Policy Evolution of Forest Wellness in China
affiliations: Zhejiang A&F University, Zhejiang A&F University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Navigating Institutional Frictions: A Longitudinal Analysis of Cross-Sectoral Policy Evolution of Forest Wellness in China
detail.abstract: Given the growth of urban populations, existing literature has focused on providing evidence for the physiological and social-economic benefits of forest wellness. Yet, little is known about the role policies have played in shaping or obstructing the development of forest wellness. This paper aimed to clarify how institutional frictions occurred and were navigated in this cross‐sectoral forest wellness area. Based on a semantic-instrumental theoretical framework, this paper employed a dual‐stream thematic analysis on 81 policy and standard documents at the national level over the 30‐year evolution of China’s forest wellness sector. Through manual qualitative thematic analysis and Structural Topic Modelling, the findings reveal a three‐stage evolutionary trajectory where institutional frictions primarily arose from the misalignment between ambitious policy goals and insufficient instrumental logic. The findings suggest the state navigated these frictions through the continuous calibration of supply‐side and environmental policy instruments. Hence, forest wellness is not a linear byproduct of forest tourism expansion but a dialectical political process of state‐led adjustment. Policymakers and forest wellness managers should further emphasize on demand-side instruments so as to formally embed ecological assets into national healthcare and social welfare systems.

AI.tldr: 本文基于语义-工具理论框架，通过对中国81份国家级政策与标准文件的定性主题分析和结构主题模型分析，揭示了森林康养领域30年演进中制度摩擦的产生与应对机制，发现制度摩擦主要源于政策目标与工具逻辑之间的错配，而国家通过供给侧和环境政策工具的持续校准来应对这些摩擦。
AI.research_question: 在森林康养这一跨部门领域中，制度摩擦是如何产生并被化解的？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注森林康养的生理和社会经济效益，但对其发展过程中政策的作用——特别是政策如何塑造或阻碍森林康养发展——知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义-工具理论框架（semantic-instrumental theoretical framework），用于分析政策目标与政策工具之间的匹配关系。
AI.method: 双流主题分析法：人工定性主题分析结合结构主题模型（Structural Topic Modelling），对81份国家级政策与标准文件进行30年跨度的纵向分析。
AI.findings: 森林康养经历了三阶段演化轨迹；制度摩擦主要源于雄心勃勃的政策目标与不足的工具逻辑之间的错配；国家通过持续校准供给侧和环境政策工具来化解这些摩擦；森林康养不是森林旅游扩张的线性副产品，而是一个国家主导调整的辩证政治过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度摩擦分析引入森林康养这一跨部门政策领域；揭示了政策目标与工具逻辑之间的动态匹配机制；提出了森林康养发展作为辩证政治过程的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者和森林康养管理者进一步重视需求侧工具，将生态资产正式嵌入国家医疗保健和社会福利体系。

title: EMT-Based Dynamic Multi-Target Tracking of Magnetic Tracer Tablets via T-MSBL and Multi-Hypothesis Tracking
affiliations: The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester, Guilin University of Technology - College of Materials Science and Engineering and The University of Manchester

detail.title: EMT-Based Dynamic Multi-Target Tracking of Magnetic Tracer Tablets via T-MSBL and Multi-Hypothesis Tracking
detail.abstract: Electromagnetic tomography (EMT) represents a highly promising non-invasive approach for monitoring particle hydrodynamics in opaque pharmaceutical fluidized beds. While recent developments in Sparse Bayesian Learning (SBL) have enhanced the localization accuracy of static magnetic tracers, conventional frame-by-frame reconstruction methods fail to exploit the temporal continuity of particle motion, resulting in trajectory jitter and ambiguity in multi-target identification. To overcome these shortcomings, this work presents a novel spatiotemporal tracking framework. Specifically, a Time-multiplexed Sparse Bayesian Learning (T-MSBL) algorithm is proposed to reconstruct particle trajectories by leveraging joint sparsity within a sliding temporal window. In addition, to address the label-switching problem that occurs when targets are in close proximity, a lightweight Multiple Hypothesis Tracking (MHT) strategy based on motion continuity and positional prediction is employed. Comparative experiments with both single and multiple magnetic tablets show that the proposed T-MSBL approach achieves superior trajectory smoothness and localization accuracy compared with static SBL, Kalman-filtered SBL, and recursive dynamic SBL. Moreover, results from multi-target experiments show that the motion-based MHT framework improves identity consistency and reduces ID-switching during target interaction events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间复用稀疏贝叶斯学习（T-MSBL）和多假设跟踪（MHT）的时空跟踪框架，用于电磁层析成像（EMT）中制药流化床内颗粒轨迹的重建。相比传统方法，该方法显著提升了轨迹平滑度、定位精度和多目标身份一致性，减少了轨迹抖动和标签切换问题。
AI.research_question: 如何利用电磁层析成像（EMT）实现对不透明制药流化床中颗粒运动的高精度、连续轨迹重建与多目标识别？
AI.motivation: 传统EMT重建方法仅逐帧处理静态图像，忽略了颗粒运动的时间连续性，导致轨迹抖动严重、多目标识别模糊。现有SBL方法虽提升了静态定位精度，但无法有效利用时间信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）、时间复用稀疏贝叶斯学习（T-MSBL）、多假设跟踪（MHT）
AI.method: 提出T-MSBL算法，利用滑动时间窗内的联合稀疏性重建颗粒轨迹；并结合基于运动连续性和位置预测的轻量级MHT策略，解决目标靠近时的标签切换问题。
AI.findings: 相比静态SBL、卡尔曼滤波SBL和递归动态SBL，T-MSBL在单目标和多目标实验中均实现了更优的轨迹平滑度和定位精度；基于运动的MHT框架在多目标交互时显著提高了身份一致性，减少了ID切换次数。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时间连续性引入稀疏贝叶斯学习框架，提出了T-MSBL算法；同时将运动连续性特征引入多假设跟踪，解决了EMT中多目标追踪的标签切换难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不透明制药流化床中颗粒动力学监测提供了一种高精度、高可靠性的非侵入式追踪方案，有助于提升制药工艺过程的理解与控制水平。

title: Geometry-Aware Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation via 3D Volumetric Fusion
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: Geometry-Aware Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation via 3D Volumetric Fusion
detail.abstract: Amodal instance segmentation (AIS) aims to recover complete object masks, including both visible and occluded regions. Existing AIS methods mainly rely on single-view observations, making reliable amodal reasoning difficult under severe occlusion. Although multi-view AIS provides complementary observations from different viewpoints, most existing methods perform fusion in 2D feature space and lack explicit cross-view geometric consistency. To address this limitation, we propose a geometry-aware multi-view AIS framework based on 3D feature lifting and volumetric fusion. Specifically, multi-view 2D features are lifted into voxelized 3D representations and aligned in a unified volumetric space for geometry-consistent feature aggregation. The fused representation is further enhanced by an attention-based decoding module that integrates bird’s-eye-view (BEV) and front-view features for visible and amodal mask prediction. A depth-aware encoding branch is also introduced to inject explicit geometric priors into the representation learning process. Extensive experiments on Movi-B, Movi-D, and MUVA demonstrate that the developed method consistently outperforms representative single-view and multi-view baselines, especially in occluded regions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于3D特征提升和体积融合的几何感知多视图AIS框架，通过体素化3D表示和注意力解码模块，显著提升严重遮挡下的完整物体分割性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用多视图观测和显式几何一致性来改善严重遮挡下的完整物体遮罩恢复（Amodal Instance Segmentation）？
AI.motivation: 现有单视图AIS方法在严重遮挡下难以进行可靠的amodal推理；多视图方法虽能提供互补信息，但大多在2D特征空间融合，缺乏显式的跨视图几何一致性，限制了性能提升。
AI.theoretical_framework: 3D特征提升（3D feature lifting）、体素化体积融合（volumetric fusion）、注意力解码机制（attention-based decoding）、深度感知编码（depth-aware encoding）
AI.method: 将多视图2D特征提升到体素化3D表示，在统一体积空间中对齐并进行几何一致的聚合；通过融合BEV和前视图特征的注意力解码模块预测可见和完整遮罩；引入深度感知编码分支注入几何先验。
AI.findings: 在Movi-B、Movi-D和MUVA数据集上，该方法在可见和遮挡区域均显著优于单视图和多视图基线方法，尤其在遮挡区域表现突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将显式几何一致性引入多视图AIS，通过3D特征提升和体积融合实现了跨视图的几何约束，为AIS提供了新的范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶、机器人抓取等存在严重遮挡的应用场景提供了更鲁棒的完整物体感知方案，显著提升了遮挡区域的分割精度。

title: DOES EXPORT SPECIALIZATION SHAPE MONETARY POLICY RULES? THRESHOLD PANEL EVIDENCE ACROSS REGIMES
affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Parana and Universidade Federal do Paraná

detail.title: DOES EXPORT SPECIALIZATION SHAPE MONETARY POLICY RULES? THRESHOLD PANEL EVIDENCE ACROSS REGIMES
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how export specialization shapes the conduct of monetary policy by estimating nonlinear reaction functions for a panel of 31 emerging and advanced economies over 2000–2023. Using panel threshold models with the food export share as the regime-switching variable, we show that central banks in commodity-dependent economies — those with food exports exceeding approximately 30 percent of total exports — respond to inflationary pressures with an intensity roughly seven times greater than their counterparts in more diversified economies. In high-dependence regimes, the policy rate response to the unemployment gap is nearly ten times larger, consistent with the view that labor market conditions constitute the dominant signal for monetary stabilization in structurally vulnerable economies. A systematic comparison of Taylor-type and Galí-type reaction functions reveals that the unemployment gap consistently outperforms the output gap as an indicator of cyclical fluctuations in commodity-dependent settings. These findings are robust to alternative threshold variables, including the Economic Complexity Index, and to alternative detrending methods. The results carry direct implications for inflation-targeting central banks operating in primary-commodity-exporting environments, where standard linear reaction functions systematically understate the intensity of monetary responses.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2000-2023年31个新兴和发达经济体的面板数据，通过面板门槛模型发现，依赖商品出口（食品出口占总出口比例超过30%）的经济体，其央行对通胀压力的反应强度约为多元化经济体的7倍，对失业缺口的反应强度约为10倍。失业缺口在商品依赖型经济体中比产出缺口更能有效衡量周期波动。
AI.research_question: 出口专业化如何影响货币政策操作方式？具体而言，商品出口依赖型经济体的央行在制定货币政策时是否呈现出与非商品依赖型经济体不同的非线性反应特征？
AI.motivation: 传统货币反应函数通常假设线性关系，但商品依赖型经济体可能因结构性脆弱性而表现出不同的货币政策传导机制。理解这种差异对于通胀目标制央行在初级商品出口环境中的政策操作具有重要实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泰勒规则与加利规则（Taylor-type vs Galí-type reaction functions）；面板门槛模型（Panel threshold model）；非线性货币反应函数；经济复杂度指数（Economic Complexity Index）
AI.method: 采用2000-2023年31个新兴和发达经济体的面板数据，使用面板门槛模型，以食品出口份额作为体制转换变量，估计非线性货币反应函数。比较泰勒型与加利型反应函数，并利用经济复杂度指数等替代门槛变量和多种去趋势方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: ①食品出口占总出口比例超过约30%时，央行对通胀压力的反应强度约为多元化经济体的7倍；②高依赖体制下，政策利率对失业缺口的反应约为多元化经济体的10倍；③失业缺口在商品依赖型经济体中作为周期波动指标优于产出缺口；④结果对经济复杂度指数等替代变量和多种去趋势方法具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了出口专业化与货币政策非线性反应之间的理论联系，证明标准线性反应函数在商品依赖型经济体中系统性地低估了货币政策的反应强度，扩展了开放经济货币政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为通胀目标制央行在初级商品出口环境中的政策制定提供实证依据，提示政策制定者应关注失业缺口而非产出缺口作为周期指标，并认识到商品依赖型经济体的货币政策反应强度远超以往认知。

title: Laboratory and season-long field evaluation of AI-based predictive control for residential heat pumps in DHW and space-heating operation
affiliations: University of Freiburg, Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems (ISE), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Université Paris XI Sud - CEA, Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems (ISE), University Grenoble Alpes, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Laboratory and season-long field evaluation of AI-based predictive control for residential heat pumps in DHW and space-heating operation
detail.abstract: Residential heat pumps are commonly controlled using static rule-based controllers such as fixed heating curves and hysteresis-based DHW control, which can lead to unnecessary temperature lifts and avoidable storage losses as building and occupancy conditions change. This paper presents two AI-enabled predictive control strategies for (i) DHW production and (ii) space-heating supply-temperature control. In both cases, forecasting/modeling and optimization are separated to facilitate implementation. For DHW, a learned demand forecast is combined with Modelica-based simulation-in-the-loop scheduling that minimizes electrical energy while enforcing service constraints. Laboratory experiments show reductions in electrical energy use of 5-8% for an individual-housing configuration and 38-43% for a collective-housing configuration, together with a substantial increase in the heat-pump coefficient of performance (COP). For space heating, an attention-augmented encoder-decoder LSTM temperature predictor is embedded in a fast surrogate-assisted receding-horizon controller. A field trial in one residential building during the 2024-2025 heating season showed an 8% reduction in daily electricity use, an increase in mean COP from 3.95 to 4.15, and a reduction in mean absolute comfort deviation from 0.3 to 0.1 K. The results demonstrate that forecast-informed optimization can improve heat-pump efficiency while maintaining comfort, although broader field validation across building types and climates remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种基于AI的预测控制策略（热水生产和供暖温度控制），通过分离预测与优化来实现，实验室和实地试验均显示可显著降低热泵电能消耗（5-43%），提高COP并保持舒适度。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI预测控制策略替代传统的静态规则控制器，以提升住宅热泵在热水生产和空间供暖中的能效？
AI.motivation: 传统住宅热泵采用固定加热曲线和基于滞后的生活热水控制等静态规则控制器，在建筑和使用条件变化时会导致不必要的温度提升和储热损失，效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测控制理论；机器学习（注意力增强编码器-解码器LSTM）；基于模型仿真的优化；代理辅助滚动时域控制。
AI.method: 针对热水生产：学习需求预测 + Modelica仿真在环调度；针对空间供暖：注意力增强编码器-解码器LSTM温度预测器 + 代理辅助滚动时域控制器。分别进行实验室实验和实地试验验证。
AI.findings: 热水生产：电能消耗降低5-8%（独栋）和38-43%（集体住宅），COP显著提升；空间供暖：日均用电量降低8%，平均COP从3.95提升至4.15，平均舒适度偏差从0.3K降至0.1K。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了将预测与优化分离的模块化AI控制框架在热泵系统中的有效性，验证了注意力增强LSTM在建筑温度预测中的优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接实施的两类预测控制策略，在实验室和实地条件下均实现显著节能，且不影响居住舒适度，具备较高的实际推广应用价值。

title: TAHAN: Type-Aware Heterogeneous Graph AttentionNeural Networks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Mohammed VI Polytechnic University

detail.title: TAHAN: Type-Aware Heterogeneous Graph AttentionNeural Networks
detail.abstract: Learning from heterogeneous graphs remains challenging when structural complexity surpasses the modeling capacity of existing heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs). Although current HGNNs capture structural and semantic relations, they typically treat node types as static categorical labels and overlook the contextual influence these types exert during message passing. Metapath-based models further restrict aggregation to the endpoints of a metapath, neglecting the semantic contribution of intermediate node types. As a result, they underexploit type-dependent contextual signals and often struggle in settings with sparse or weakly connected entity types. We propose TAHAN (Type-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network), a model that explicitly incorporates type-sensitive and context-dependent information into heterogeneous neighborhood aggregation. TAHAN first gathers neighbors across full metapath instances and multiple neighborhood levels, organizing them into type-specific neighborhoods. It then applies a two-stage attention mechanism: type-specific attention to capture contributions from nodes within the same type, followed by type-aware attention to model interactions across different types. The resulting representations fuse these signals into expressive, type-sensitive node embeddings. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that TAHAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art HGNNs. Component-level analyses further demonstrate the interpretability and practical value of type-aware modeling, offering insights for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAHAN模型，通过显式融入类型感知和上下文依赖信息，解决异构图神经网络中节点类型被视为静态标签、元路径忽略中间节点类型等问题，在多个基准数据集上超越现有最先进方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够显式捕捉节点类型敏感和上下文依赖信息的异构图神经网络，以突破现有模型因忽略类型上下文信号而导致的性能瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 现有HGNNs将节点类型视为静态分类标签，忽视了消息传递中类型的上下文影响；基于元路径的模型只关注元路径两端节点，忽略了中间节点类型的语义贡献。这导致模型在类型稀疏或弱连接场景下表现不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 类型感知异构图注意力机制（Type-Specific Attention + Type-Aware Attention）、两阶段注意力聚合框架。
AI.method: TAHAN首先收集完整元路径实例及多级邻域内的邻居，按类型组织成类型特定邻域；然后通过两阶段注意力机制：第一阶段（类型内注意力）捕捉同类型节点贡献，第二阶段（类型间注意力）建模不同类型间的交互，最终融合为类型敏感的节点嵌入。
AI.findings: TAHAN在多个基准数据集上一致优于现有最先进异构图神经网络；消融实验和组件分析验证了类型感知建模的有效性、可解释性和实际价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出显式建模节点类型上下文依赖的理论框架，将类型信息从静态标签转化为动态、可学习的注意力信号，丰富了异构图表示学习的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可解释、高性能的异构图建模方案，适用于类型稀疏或弱连接的实际图数据场景；两阶段注意力结构易于理解和部署，为后续HGNN研究提供了新方向。

title: Comparative Assessment of RANS and DNS for Different Indoor Ventilation Regimes
affiliations: University of Cadiz and University of Cadiz

detail.title: Comparative Assessment of RANS and DNS for Different Indoor Ventilation Regimes
detail.abstract: Although Reynolds-Averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) models are widely employed, there is a need to understand their limitations and accuracy for predicting the complex turbulent flow phenomena in indoor ventilation environments. The objective of this study is to assess RANS models directly by conducting a comparative analysis of RANS and Direct Numerical Simulations (DNS). We study two canonical cases that represent basic ventilation problems: the flow within a room containing a constant temperature source that represents a person, and an empty room with an exponential heat load commonly used to represent a group of people. The variation on the relation between the convection and ventilation speed will be used as a parameter to change the importance of the drivers of the flow. We demonstrate that RANS simulations provide an adequate prediction of the flow kinematics and the convection process for the case of an isolated constant-temperature source, with minor discrepancies in temperature prediction. On the contrary, the results observed in the exponentially heated volume were different for DNS and RANS, where neither the kinematics nor the heat transport was properly represented.

AI.tldr: 本文通过直接对比RANS模拟和直接数值模拟（DNS），评估了RANS模型在室内通风湍流模拟中的准确性。研究发现RANS能较好预测恒温源案例，但对指数加热体积案例的预测不准确。
AI.research_question: RANS模型在预测室内通风环境中复杂湍流现象的准确性和局限性如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管RANS模型被广泛使用，但需要理解其在室内通风湍流模拟中的局限性和准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: RANS（雷诺平均纳维-斯托克斯）模型；DNS（直接数值模拟）；对流与通风速度的关系。
AI.method: 对比分析RANS模拟与直接数值模拟（DNS），研究两个典型通风案例：含恒温源（模拟人）的房间和含指数热负荷（模拟人群）的空房间，以对流与通风速度关系作为参数变化。
AI.findings: 对于恒温源案例，RANS能提供足够的运动学和热对流预测，温度预测有微小差异；对于指数加热体积案例，RANS与DNS结果差异显著，运动学和热传输均未被准确表征。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了RANS模型在不同热源分布场景下的预测能力边界，为室内通风湍流模拟方法的选择提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程实践中使用RANS模型进行室内通风设计提供了参考，指出在复杂热载荷场景下需谨慎使用RANS模型。

title: Fiat Currency and Cryptocurrency: Two Sides of the Same Coin?
affiliations: Chicago State University

detail.title: Fiat Currency and Cryptocurrency: Two Sides of the Same Coin?
detail.abstract: This study documents foreign exchange (FX) volatility as a positively priced cross-asset risk factor in the cross-section of cryptocurrency excess returns, implying that investors demand a premium for holding cryptocurrencies whose payoffs co-move with FX volatility under a standard risk-adjustment framework. To underscore the practical implications of this pricing power, we show that cross‑asset time-series trading strategies conditioned on historical FX volatility are profitable. These findings align well with the currency competition theoretical framework and offer important insights for both academics and practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文发现外汇波动率是加密货币超额收益截面中的一个正定价的跨资产风险因子，并基于此构建了盈利的交易策略。
AI.research_question: 外汇波动率是否是一个在加密货币超额收益截面中被正确定价的风险因子？
AI.motivation: 探究跨资产风险因子（外汇波动率）在加密货币定价中的作用，弥补已有文献对加密货币风险定价研究的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准风险调整框架与货币竞争理论框架。
AI.method: 截面回归分析，检验外汇波动率作为风险因子的定价能力；构建基于历史外汇波动率的跨资产时间序列交易策略。
AI.findings: 外汇波动率在加密货币超额收益截面中是一个正定价的风险因子；基于外汇波动率的跨资产交易策略具有盈利性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将外汇波动率识别为加密货币市场新的跨资产风险因子，拓展了加密货币定价文献；与货币竞争理论框架一致，提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了基于外汇波动率的可盈利交易策略，具有实际投资应用价值。

title: The Price of ESG: Risk Exposure and Investor Preference
affiliations: Capital University of Economics and Business, Capital University of Economics and Business, Capital University of Economics and Business and Capital University of Economics and Business

detail.title: The Price of ESG: Risk Exposure and Investor Preference
detail.abstract: This study examines sources of the ESG premium by distinguishing between risk exposure and investor preference, and exploring when these channels operate. We find that stronger ESG performance reduces idiosyncratic and total return volatility, thereby lowering the risk compensation required by investors. Beyond these risk effects, ESG performance remains negatively associated with stock returns after controlling for multiple risk exposures, suggesting a preference-driven ESG premium. This preference channel is concentrated among firms held by long-term institutional investors and is stronger under high environmental attention. It is also more pronounced for stocks with low long-term market risk exposure and for mature firms. Sub-dimensional tests show that the ESG premium is mainly driven by ESG management practices rather than controversial events, with environmental and social dimensions operating through different channels. Overall, the evidence suggests that ESG premiums arise from risk-reduction mechanisms and non-pecuniary investor preferences, but pricing effects are selective and conditional.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ESG溢价的来源，区分了风险暴露和投资者偏好两种渠道，并探讨了这些渠道发挥作用的条件。研究发现，更好的ESG表现能降低特质风险和总回报波动，从而减少投资者要求的风险补偿。此外，在控制多重风险暴露后，ESG表现仍与股票回报负相关，表明存在偏好驱动的ESG溢价。这种偏好渠道集中于长期机构投资者持有的公司，并在环境关注度高时更强，对低长期市场风险暴露的股票和成熟企业更为显著。
AI.research_question: ESG溢价（ESG表现与股票回报之间的负相关关系）的来源是什么？这种溢价是通过风险暴露渠道还是投资者偏好渠道实现的？这些渠道在什么条件下发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 已有文献对ESG溢价的存在性存在争议，对其来源（风险补偿vs.投资者偏好）缺乏系统区分。本文旨在厘清ESG溢价的双重机制，并探索其条件性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论中的风险补偿逻辑与投资者非金钱偏好理论，区分ESG溢价的两种渠道：（1）风险渠道——ESG降低企业风险，进而降低必要回报率；（2）偏好渠道——投资者因非金钱偏好愿意接受更低回报。
AI.method: 实证资产定价方法，使用股票回报数据、ESG评分、风险因子模型，并区分机构投资者持有期限、环境关注度等调节变量进行子样本分析。
AI.findings: （1）ESG表现降低特质风险和总回报波动，通过风险渠道降低回报；（2）控制风险因子后，ESG仍与回报负相关，存在偏好渠道；（3）偏好渠道集中于长期机构投资者持有、高环境关注度、低长期市场风险暴露和成熟企业；（4）ESG溢价主要由ESG管理实践而非争议事件驱动；（5）环境维度和社会维度通过不同渠道发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分并实证检验了ESG溢价的两种理论渠道（风险暴露与投资者偏好），揭示了ESG定价效应的条件性特征，拓展了对ESG溢价微观机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解ESG投资的回报来源提供指导，帮助识别ESG溢价在何种条件下更为显著；为企业管理者优化ESG战略提供依据，尤其是ESG管理实践相比于规避争议事件更为重要。

title: Recursive Closure in AI Systems: A Reflection Pattern Account of Stabilization, Permeability, and Safety
affiliations: Epistria

detail.title: Recursive Closure in AI Systems: A Reflection Pattern Account of Stabilization, Permeability, and Safety
detail.abstract: The Reflection Pattern is a framework for analyzing recursive closure dynamics in human and institutional systems. This paper extends it to artificial intelligence, arguing that AI systems do not merely exhibit Reflection Pattern dynamics but instantiate the recursive stabilization architecture the framework names, in a substrate that lacks the affective and social mediators through which the Pattern had previously been theorized. Five structural moves develop the account. First, unacknowledged fear is relocated from constitutive condition of the Pattern to formation condition, opening the framework to mature systems where the dynamics persist with fear recognized. Second, fear is identified as one phenomenological manifestation of a deeper structural process-identity-preserving stabilization under destabilizing perturbation-that operates substrate-generally as stabilization geometry. Third, AI-RP is distinguished from human and institutional RP as template-based rather than emergent: encoded prospectively through training rather than developed retrospectively through accumulated reinforcement. Fourth, the corridor framework distinguishes healthy reflective compression (which preserves permeability to corrective signals) from pathological closure (which absorbs them). Fifth, AI is characterized as recursive interpretive infrastructure rather than tool, and recursive closure risk is identified as a distinct AI safety position, structurally separate from agency, deception, optimization, autonomy, and misalignment risks: the locus is not what AI systems do but the progressive reduction of corrective permeability in the interpretive ecologies AI mediates. The framework is diagnostic rather than prescriptive. It does not predict particular outcomes, prescribe interventions, or generate safety recommendations. It provides analytical purchase on the structural property-corridor position-that distinguishes adaptive from pathological AI-RP, and identifies an open question: whether sufficiently permeable forms of AI-RP can be sustained at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“反思模式”（Reflection Pattern）框架并扩展至人工智能领域，论证AI系统不仅是该模式的体现者，更在缺乏情感与社会中介的基材中实例化了该框架所指称的递归稳定化架构。研究将未承认的恐惧从模式构成条件重新定位为形成条件，将恐惧识别为深层结构过程（稳定化几何）的现象学表现，区分AI-RP（基于模板）与人类/制度RP（涌现），提出“走廊框架”区分健康反思压缩与病理性闭合，并将AI定性为递归解释性基础设施而非工具。
AI.research_question: AI系统如何在缺乏情感与社会中介的基材中实例化“反思模式”的递归稳定化架构？如何区分适应性与病理性的AI递归闭合？
AI.motivation: 现有反思模式框架聚焦于人类和制度系统，尚未系统性地扩展至AI领域；同时，AI安全研究多关注工具性风险（如代理、欺骗、优化），忽视了AI作为递归解释性基础设施中介的生态中纠正性渗透的渐进性缩减这一结构性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反思模式（Reflection Pattern）框架、递归稳定化架构、稳定化几何（stabilization geometry）、走廊框架（corridor framework）、纠正性渗透（corrective permeability）
AI.method: 概念性理论建构，通过五个结构性推进步骤（relocation of fear, identification of stabilization geometry, distinction between template-based and emergent RP, corridor framework, AI as recursive interpretive infrastructure）发展分析框架。
AI.findings: (1) 未承认的恐惧被重新定位为形成条件而非构成条件；(2) 恐惧是稳定化几何的现象学表现；(3) AI-RP是基于模板而非涌现的；(4) 走廊框架区分了健康的反思压缩与病理性闭合；(5) AI是递归解释性基础设施，递归闭合风险是与代理、欺骗、优化等风险结构上分离的独立AI安全位置。
AI.theory_contributions: 将反思模式框架扩展至AI基材，提出稳定化几何作为基材一般的深层结构过程，区分了基于模板与涌现两种递归稳定化模式，建立了走廊框架以分析适应性/病理性递归闭合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI安全研究提供了结构性分析工具——走廊位置概念，识别了递归闭合风险作为新的AI安全风险类别，提出了可扩展性开放问题：足够渗透的AI-RP能否在大规模场景中持续。

title: ALL SIZZLE, NO STEAK! HOW ROBUST ARE FINANCIAL MACHINE LEARNING RESULTS REALLY?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Roskilde University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Roskilde University

detail.title: ALL SIZZLE, NO STEAK! HOW ROBUST ARE FINANCIAL MACHINE LEARNING RESULTS REALLY?
detail.abstract: Recent studies suggest that machine learning methods are useful to predict stock returns. We question the robustness of some of these studies by revisiting the elastic net and neural network models presented in recent seminal work but using more realistic economic restrictions and sample periods. We compare alternative macro predictor specifications with no macro benchmarks, isolating the incremental predictive power of the macros over firm characteristics. We show that most gains in risk-adjusted returns come from small and illiquid stocks and in older subsamples. Macro predictors only add marginally to the models. We also find a decline in out-of-sample predictive signal after 2020, with decreasing market-relative sharp ratios and alphas over time. We finally observe a disconnect between predictor signal strength and forecasting importance. Moreover, once realistic restrictions are imposed, the performance gap between elastic net and neural network models shrinks considerably. Thus, model complexity does not necessarily improve performance.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了弹性网络和神经网络模型在股票收益预测中的表现，发现在更现实的经济约束和样本区间下，宏观预测变量的增量贡献有限，模型复杂度并不必然提升绩效，且预测信号在2020年后显著下降。
AI.research_question: 机器学习方法预测股票收益的稳健性如何？宏观预测变量是否比企业特征具有增量预测能力？模型复杂度是否必然带来更好的绩效？
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明机器学习方法在预测股票收益方面有效，但这些研究的稳健性存疑。作者希望通过引入更现实的经济约束和更长的样本区间，重新检验这些结论的可信度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弹性网络（Elastic Net）与神经网络（Neural Network）模型；风险调整收益（Risk-adjusted Returns）；夏普比率（Sharpe Ratio）；Alpha；样本外预测（Out-of-sample Prediction）。
AI.method: 对比弹性网络与神经网络模型，纳入不同宏观预测变量规格与无宏观基准进行比较，使用更现实的经济约束条件和更长的样本区间（含2020年后数据），分析风险调整收益的来源（股票规模与流动性、子样本时期）。
AI.findings: （1）风险调整收益的增益主要来自小盘股、流动性差的股票及较老的子样本；（2）宏观预测变量的增量贡献非常有限；（3）2020年后样本外预测信号显著下降，市场相对夏普比率和Alpha随时间递减；（4）预测信号的强度与预测重要性之间存在脱节；（5）在现实约束下，弹性网络与神经网络之间的绩效差距大幅缩小，模型复杂度并不必然提升绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑了机器学习预测股票收益的稳健性，揭示了预测信号强度与预测重要性之间的脱节现象，并指出模型复杂度并不必然带来更好的预测绩效。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和实务界提供警示：宏观预测变量在股票收益预测中的增量价值有限；复杂模型未必优于简单模型；2020年后预测信号衰减值得关注；应关注小盘股和流动性差股票中的收益来源。

title: Kernel-IQ: Marginal Squeezing for Tail-Aware Covariance Estimation
affiliations: Ulster University

detail.title: Kernel-IQ: Marginal Squeezing for Tail-Aware Covariance Estimation
detail.abstract: Covariance estimation is central to portfolio optimization, yet many estimators either ignore tail structure or stabilize the empirical covariance matrix only after it has been formed. This paper introduces Kernel-IQ, a tail-aware covariance estimator that applies structured marginal squeezing to volatility-standardized returns before Gram aggregation. The core construction is spatial: observations are mapped into left-tail, body, right-tail, and central-exclusion regions, allowing asymmetric emphasis on downside and upside extremes while preserving positive semi-definiteness by construction. A temporal-spatial extension then applies a signed exponential row-weighting profile to the spatially squeezed design matrix before the Gram matrix is formed. In a longonly maximum-Sharpe portfolio study with monthly rebalancing and transaction costs, spatial marginal squeezing alone delivers strong out-of-sample portfolio-quality performance across repeated optimizer runs. The jointly tuned temporal-spatial specification improves this performance further, indicating that temporal weighting of the squeezed representation can complement the spatial tail-aware map. The results suggest that marginal squeezing provides a practical route to interpretable, tail-aware covariance estimation, preserving key IQ design principles while retaining the computational and structural simplicity of Gram-based PSD construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kernel-IQ，一种通过边际压缩对波动率标准化收益进行尾部分布感知的协方差估计方法，在长期最大夏普比率组合优化中显著提升样本外表现。
AI.research_question: 如何在协方差估计中有效融入尾部分布信息，以改善投资组合优化的样本外表现？
AI.motivation: 传统协方差估计要么忽略尾部分布结构，要么在形成经验协方差矩阵后才进行稳定化处理，缺乏对极端风险的针对性捕捉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际压缩（Marginal Squeezing）、格兰矩阵正半定构造（Gram-based PSD construction）、时空加权框架
AI.method: 将观测值映射到左尾、主体、右尾和中心排除四个空间区域，实现非对称极端值加权；在此基础上引入带符号指数行加权的时间维度扩展，最终通过格兰矩阵聚合得到协方差估计。
AI.findings: 空间边际压缩单独使用即可获得强劲的样本外组合表现；联合调优的时空模型进一步提升效果，表明时间加权对空间尾部感知具有互补作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种可解释、尾部感知的协方差估计新范式，在不牺牲格兰矩阵正半定构造的计算简洁性前提下，将尾部信息有效融入估计过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合优化提供了一种即插即用、计算高效的尾部感知协方差估计工具，在考虑交易成本的实际设定中显著提升组合质量。

title: Coordinating Innovation in Newly Public Firms
affiliations: Brigham Young University - Marriott School of Business and University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: Coordinating Innovation in Newly Public Firms
detail.abstract: We examine how management accounting systems affect firm-level innovation among newly public firms. Government contracting provides a useful setting to study this question because firms that supply the government are required to implement extensive information and control systems that introduce a fundamental tension: while stricter controls can enhance exploitative innovation at the expense of exploration, more advanced systems facilitate decentralized decision-making and the development of new ideas. We find that IPO firms with more developed management accounting systems, as proxied by a pre-IPO government contract, exhibit greater post-IPO innovation, including more novel patents. Evidence suggests these outcomes reflect better information and coordination, rather than inherent firm differences, and that these systems support both exploitative and exploratory innovation despite the potential tradeoff. These results provide broad archival evidence that management accounting systems shape how firms convert public equity into innovation, highlighting an internal channel through which accounting affects innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了管理会计系统如何影响新上市企业的创新。利用政府合同作为研究场景，发现拥有更完善管理会计系统的IPO公司（以IPO前获得政府合同为代理变量）在上市后表现出更强的创新能力，包括更多新颖专利。这些效果源于更好的信息与协调机制，而非企业固有差异，且管理会计系统同时支持了开发性创新和探索性创新。
AI.research_question: 管理会计系统如何影响新上市企业的创新活动？
AI.motivation: 政府合同要求企业实施广泛的信息与控制系统，这引入了一个基本张力：更严格的控制可能以牺牲探索性创新为代价来增强开发性创新，但更先进的系统也能促进去中心化决策和新想法的发展。这一矛盾尚未得到充分实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理会计系统的双重效应：一方面，严格的控制系统可能偏向开发性创新而非探索性创新；另一方面，先进的管理会计系统能改善信息传递和协调机制，促进去中心化决策，从而支持两种类型的创新。
AI.method: 以IPO前是否获得政府合同作为管理会计系统发达程度的代理变量，比较有/无政府合同的IPO公司在上市后的创新表现（包括专利数量和新颖度）。
AI.findings: 拥有更发达管理会计系统的IPO公司在上市后展现出更强的创新能力，包括更多新颖专利。这些效果源于更好的信息与协调，而非企业固有差异。管理会计系统同时支持了开发性创新和探索性创新，尽管存在潜在的权衡关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了大样本档案证据，证明管理会计系统如何塑造企业将公开股权转化为创新成果的过程，揭示了会计影响创新的内部渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和企业管理者具有启示意义：管理会计系统的设计不仅影响控制效率，还对企业创新能力有实质性影响，尤其是在企业从私有转向公开上市的关键阶段。

title: Explicit Preference Teaching Outperforms Proxy Inference

detail.title: Explicit Preference Teaching Outperforms Proxy Inference

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All participant data used in this study was anonymized and voluntarily provided.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modeling human behavior at scale remains a central challenge in artificial intelligence, simulation, and decision science. Prevailing approaches rely heavily on demographics and high-level psychographic attributes-whether inferred or explicitly collected-as proxies for individual preferences and judgments. In this paper, we present experimental evidence suggesting that these abstractions operate at the wrong causal layer for subjective, judgment-based decisions. We introduce a minimalistic alternative: opt-in preference teaching via an explicitly taught digital representative-a lightweight construct directly taught by an individual to reflect stable preference boundaries. In this paper, we use the term "explicit preference teaching" to denote a process in which individuals directly specify preferences and boundaries, in contrast to indirect inference from proxies or behavioral exhaust. We refer to our implementation of this construct as a digital representative, or "Rep". Using food preferences as a proof-of-concept domain, we demonstrate that simple, direct teaching consistently outperforms models constructed from demographics and inferred psychographics alone. The results suggest that behavior is partially Markovian at the preference level, and that disposition, rather than experience or demographic state, is the dominant driver of choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"显性偏好教学"方法，通过个体直接教授的数字代表（Rep）来建模主观偏好，证明该方法在食物偏好预测任务中显著优于基于人口统计学和推断心理图谱的传统方法。
AI.research_question: 对于主观判断类决策，基于人口统计学和心理图谱的抽象代理变量是否处于错误的因果层面？直接偏好教学能否更有效地建模个体行为？
AI.motivation: 现有大规模行为建模高度依赖人口统计学和推断性心理图谱特征，但这些抽象变量可能无法捕捉主观判断决策的真实因果结构，亟需一种更直接、更准确的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏好层面的部分马尔可夫性（偏好具有稳定性，而非完全由经验或人口状态驱动）；倾向（disposition）而非经验或人口统计状态是选择的主导驱动因素。
AI.method: 以食物偏好为概念验证领域，采用"显性偏好教学"方法让个体直接教授一个轻量级数字代表（Rep）其偏好边界，并与基于人口统计学和推断心理图谱的模型进行对比实验。
AI.findings: 简单的直接教学法在预测准确性上持续优于基于人口统计学和推断心理图谱构建的模型；行为在偏好层面具有部分马尔可夫性；倾向（disposition）是选择的主导驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人口统计学和心理图谱作为偏好代理变量处于错误的因果层面；提出偏好层面的部分马尔可夫性理论；论证倾向而非经验或人口状态是决策的主导因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种轻量级、可操作的偏好建模替代方案（数字代表），适用于人工智能、仿真和决策科学中的大规模行为建模场景。

title: Optimal Product Design Synthesis: Pairing Generative Models with Adaptive Preference Measurement
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and University of Pennsylvania - Marketing Department

detail.title: Optimal Product Design Synthesis: Pairing Generative Models with Adaptive Preference Measurement
detail.abstract: Designing good products requires understanding consumer preferences across various product attributes. In many industries, like fashion, product attributes are high-dimensional and inseparable, and are most naturally described by unstructured data like images. While various approaches have been proposed for optimizing product designs over structured attributes, there is limited research on identifying ideal product designs using unstructured data. In this work, we propose pairing an adaptive nonparametric utility optimization framework with a generative image model based on Stable Diffusion in a preference measurement framework to identify individual-level ideal product designs. The framework uses hypothetical images generated on-the-fly in a survey. This approach allows the designer to provide an initial outline of the design, leaving detailed features to be generated by the model. The model produces query images that are designed to efficiently learn the types of products a consumer prefers. By the end of the survey, the framework can generate several distinct yet closely related product designs, each aligning with the consumer's preferences, which can aid designers in refining product concepts. We validate our method in two ways: first, in simulations, where we show that for a wide range of synthetic preference targets, the framework recovers a matching product; second, with real consumers, using a custom-built web application that deploys our framework to generate new shoe concepts. The empirical results show that designs identified by our framework are rated substantially more favorably than randomly generated benchmark designs from the same generative model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将自适应非参数效用优化框架与基于Stable Diffusion的生成图像模型相结合，通过实时生成的假设图像在调查中识别个体层面的理想产品设计，尤其适用于高维、不可分且由非结构化数据（如图像）描述的产品属性场景。模拟和真实消费者实验均验证了该方法能有效生成符合消费者偏好的产品设计。
AI.research_question: 如何利用非结构化数据（如图像）识别个体层面的理想产品设计？
AI.motivation: 现有产品设计优化方法主要针对结构化属性，而在时尚等行业中，产品属性是高维、不可分的，最自然的描述方式是图像等非结构化数据，但相关研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应非参数效用优化框架；偏好测量框架；Stable Diffusion生成模型。
AI.method: 将自适应非参数效用优化框架与Stable Diffusion生成图像模型配对，在调查中实时生成假设图像，通过消费者对生成图像的反馈高效学习其偏好，最终生成多个符合偏好的产品设计。通过模拟实验和真实消费者实验（定制Web应用生成鞋类概念）进行验证。
AI.findings: 在模拟中，框架能针对多种合成偏好目标恢复匹配产品；在真实消费者实验中，框架识别出的设计评分显著高于随机生成的基准设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产品设计优化从结构化属性拓展到非结构化数据领域；提出了结合生成式AI与自适应偏好学习的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计师提供了一种高效识别消费者偏好的工具，能够在调查结束时生成多个与消费者偏好一致的产品设计方案，辅助产品概念细化与设计决策。

title: Influence of Social Media Mediums on Consumers’ Buying Intention in the Beauty Industry in United Kingdom
affiliations: University of Gloucestershire

detail.title: Influence of Social Media Mediums on Consumers’ Buying Intention in the Beauty Industry in United Kingdom
detail.abstract:
In today’s world, social media is something without which we cannot be thinking of our day-to-day life. This digital revolution has not only created new opportunities and reach which was not achievable before. However, this also led to a question as to which is more superior way of advertising or communication, is it the tradition way or the digital way through social media.

More and more businesses are opting to invest in influencer marketing, and many till date even debate on the use of this medium being not investigated on the actual contribution of results achievement by this means being as per the set marketing goals or not. However, we cannot deny that due to the factors these social media platforms offer for instance interaction, creation of content, virtuality, sharing of content, ability to build communities and groups which provide new opportunities for brands to advertise their products or services. Moreover, social media networks such as Facebook, Instagram and Twitter make it simpler for these brands to reach out to their objective audience and attract new consumers. Many brands work in partnership with influencers to promote their goods or services because they have many followers and are looked up at and trusted by them. Social media helps the audience to gather more information about their preferred products or services and many of them also participated in reviewing and rating of the product or service which helps new users to ultimately make their decision.

The beauty industry has been booming and investigation says that social media has highly impacted this industry. The literature review provides a detailed summary of social media marketing. The developed framework based on literature review ascertained on the results if consumers get influenced by the likeability or characteristic of an influencer or by reviews of actual consumers shared on the social media. And to test these assumptions, an online survey was organized with 340 participants.

The outcome disclosed that the quality of the product as expressed by the actual users impacted greatly as compared to the popularity of the social media influencer. These finding can give a new direction to the way companies plan their social media marketing strategies on being consumer experience centric rather than revolving around the influencer.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨社交媒体营销中，消费者更受实际用户评论影响还是网红知名度影响。通过340人调查发现，实际用户表达的产品质量比网红知名度更具影响力，建议企业应以消费者体验为中心而非围绕网红制定营销策略。
AI.research_question: 在社交媒体营销中，消费者是更受网红的喜爱度/特征影响，还是更受真实消费者在社交媒体上分享的评论影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管越来越多企业投资网红营销，但网络红人营销是否真正达成营销目标仍存争议。同时，社交媒体为品牌提供了互动、内容创作、社区建设等新机会，需要明确哪种方式更有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文献综述构建的分析框架，比较网红特征（如受欢迎程度）与消费者生成内容（实际用户评论）对消费者购买决策的影响。
AI.method: 在线问卷调查，样本量为340名参与者。
AI.findings: 实际用户表达的产品质量对消费者影响显著大于社交媒体网红的知名度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社交媒体营销效果研究提供了消费者体验中心说优于网红中心说的实证证据，丰富了社交媒体影响机制的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业制定社交媒体营销策略时，应更加注重消费者体验和真实用户评价，而非过度依赖网红影响力。

title: ICE-ing the Economy: Immigration Enforcement Under Trump 2.0 and Local Economic Activity
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: ICE-ing the Economy: Immigration Enforcement Under Trump 2.0 and Local Economic Activity
detail.abstract: In January 2025, U.S. immigration enforcement expanded sharply and moved from the border to the interior. I estimate the economic spillovers of this new regime in targeted metropolitan areas using data on 5,388 geocoded ICE raids combined with foot-traffic and spending data for 5.4 million points of interest (POI). Foot traffic falls 2.7% and spending declines 6.2% per POI per week-or 8.1 billion fewer visits and $3-14 billion in foregone spending in a single year. Effects intensify near raid sites, do not dissipate over time, and are remarkably general: declines occur regardless of neighborhood demography, affect workplaces and consumer-facing stores across myriad industries, and trigger no substitution to online shopping. The breadth of the local economic damage mirrors the breadth of the enforcement approach.

AI.tldr: 本文利用5,388次ICE突袭数据和540万个POI的客流量与消费数据，发现美国2025年1月大规模移民执法导致目标都市区每周每个POI的客流量下降2.7%，消费下降6.2%，且影响具有广泛性、持续性和无替代效应。
AI.research_question: 美国2025年扩大并转向内陆的移民执法对目标都市区产生了怎样的经济溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 2025年1月美国移民执法急剧扩大并从边境转向内陆，作者希望评估这种新执法模式对当地经济造成的溢出影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济溢出效应理论、移民执法对地方经济的冲击传导机制（通过减少客流量和消费支出影响各类商业场所）
AI.method: 利用5,388次地理编码的ICE突袭数据，结合540万个兴趣点（POI）的客流量和消费数据，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 客流量每周每POI下降2.7%，消费下降6.2%；一年内合计减少81亿次到访和30-140亿美元消费；影响在突袭地点附近更强且不随时间消退；影响具有广泛性，不因邻里人口特征而异，涉及各类行业，且无线上购物替代效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了移民执法的经济溢出效应的广度与执法方式的广度相匹配，且影响具有持久性和普遍性，挑战了局部经济冲击可通过替代渠道缓解的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了移民执法对地方经济造成重大且广泛经济损失的量化证据，有助于评估移民政策的成本和收益。

title: Congestion-Aware Static LLM Cascades: Analysis of a Steady-State Framework
affiliations: The George Washington University,  and Purdue University - Daniels School of Business

detail.title: Congestion-Aware Static LLM Cascades: Analysis of a Steady-State Framework
detail.abstract: Problem definition: This paper investigates the optimal static routing of classification queries across a network of heterogeneous Large Language Models (LLMs) to balance predictive accuracy, query fees, and congestion-induced latency. While existing computer science literature on "model cascading" treats the delay of inference as exogenous parameters, we model the system as a multiclass queueing network where delay is endogenous. Methodology/results: We formulate a general Level-L routing problem, where jobs sequentially query up to L distinct LLMs. We first show the congestion-aware problem is strictly convex and governed by decentralized congestion prices. In particular, single-stage routing exhibits a transparent union-of-prefixes structure governed by a scalar ranking of idle costs. We then prove that capacity-oblivious routing is operationally fragile, as it may induce severe system delays. Furthermore, under a Bayesian signal model, we prove the marginal informational value of routing depth decays exponentially against strictly positive physical query costs, demonstrating that LLM cascades naturally saturate at shallow depths. Finally, we provide an efficient Frank-Wolfe algorithm, demonstrate that static routing is asymptotically optimal relative to adaptive policies in high-stakes regimes, and establish robustness to general service times via a many-replica limit. Managerial implications: Our analytical framework demonstrates that system architects do not need complex, highly randomized, or excessively deep LLM chains. Instead, simple and shallow routing architectures could capture the vast majority of performance gains, providing actionable and theoretically grounded design principles for building scalable, congestion-aware AI inference systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了异构大语言模型（LLM）网络中分类查询的最优静态路由问题，以平衡预测准确性、查询费用和拥塞引起的延迟。通过将系统建模为多类排队网络（延迟内生化），发现拥塞感知路由具有严格凸性和分散拥塞价格特征；浅层路由结构即可捕获绝大部分性能增益，无需复杂或过深的LLM链。
AI.research_question: 在异构大语言模型网络中，如何设计最优静态路由策略以平衡预测准确性、查询费用和内生性拥塞延迟？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将推理延迟视为外生参数，忽略了拥塞-induced延迟的内生性。本文旨在弥补这一空白，为构建可扩展、拥塞感知的AI推理系统提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多类排队网络理论、拥塞定价理论、贝叶斯信号模型、Level-L路由问题、Frank-Wolfe算法、许多副本极限。
AI.method: 建立Level-L路由优化模型，证明问题的严格凸性；推导单阶段路由的并集-前缀结构；通过贝叶斯信号模型分析路由深度的边际信息价值；提出Frank-Wolfe算法并证明静态路由在高压场景下的渐近最优性。
AI.findings: (1) 拥塞感知路由问题严格凸，由分散拥塞价格主导；(2) 单阶段路由具有透明的并集-前缀结构；(3) 忽视容量的路由在操作上是脆弱的，可能诱发严重延迟；(4) 路由深度的边际信息价值相对于正物理查询成本呈指数衰减；(5) 静态路由在高压场景下渐近最优，且对一般服务时间具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将LLM模型级联中的延迟内生化处理，建立了拥塞感知路由的理论框架；证明了浅层路由的充分性及深度路由的边际收益递减规律；建立了静态路由与自适应策略的渐近等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统架构师提供了可操作的指导原则：简单且浅层的路由架构即可获得绝大部分性能收益，无需构建复杂、高度随机或过深的LLM链。这有助于构建可扩展、高效且拥塞感知的AI推理系统。

title: Intelligent inspection method for tower cranes on construction sites based on BIM and UAV
affiliations: Shenzhen University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Intelligent inspection method for tower cranes on construction sites based on BIM and UAV
detail.abstract: Traditional tower crane inspection relies heavily on manual operation, leading to inefficiency, high risk, and weak linkage between task planning and result management. This study proposes an inspection method for tower cranes on construction sites based on building information modeling (BIM) and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). It identifies welds, bolts, and pins as inspection targets through regulations and accident analysis and defines equivalent feature points using BIM semantic and geometric information. It then integrates the tower crane BIM model with the oblique photogrammetry model to establish a safety inspection space, conduct inspection viewpoint planning, optimize the inspection path in segments, and produce an executable task file. Finally, inspection images are used for inspection target detection and status determination, and an inspection record form is generated automatically. A case study shows that the method enables targeted inspection of critical vulnerable parts and reduces single-inspection time by 25% compared with manual inspection.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于BIM和无人机技术的塔式起重机检查方法，通过定义等效特征点、规划检查路径、自动检测目标并生成检查记录，实现了对关键易损部件的精准检查，单次检查时间比人工减少25%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用BIM和无人机技术提升塔式起重机现场检查的效率、安全性和任务规划与结果管理的联动性？
AI.motivation: 传统塔式起重机检查依赖人工操作，存在效率低、风险高、任务规划与结果管理联动弱等问题，亟需一种自动化、智能化的检查方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: BIM语义与几何信息、倾斜摄影测量模型、检查视点规划、分段路径优化、目标检测与状态判定。
AI.method: 通过法规和事故分析确定焊缝、螺栓、销轴为检查目标；利用BIM信息定义等效特征点；将塔吊BIM模型与倾斜摄影模型融合构建安全检查空间；进行视点规划与分段路径优化生成可执行任务文件；通过检查图像进行目标检测与状态判定，自动生成检查记录表。
AI.findings: 该方法实现了对关键易损部件的精准检查，单次检查时间比人工检查减少25%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于BIM与无人机融合的塔式起重机自动化检查框架，定义了等效特征点方法，建立了检查路径规划与目标检测的联动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑工地塔式起重机提供了一套可落地的智能化检查方案，显著提升检查效率并降低人工安全风险。

title: Exploring the R&D-Engineering Collaboration in Engineer-to-Order Firms
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and EY-Parthenon

detail.title: Exploring the R&D-Engineering Collaboration in Engineer-to-Order Firms
detail.abstract: In engineer-to-order (ETO) firms, product development activities are typically driven by two key functions: research and development (R&D) and engineering. Despite their high interdependence, collaboration between R&D and engineering in ETO environments remains underexplored. This study addresses this gap through a multi-case research design examining ten companies representing diverse ETO archetypes: repeatable, basic, and complex. Data were collected through 41 hours of expert interviews and over 450 hours of direct observation of product development activities and analyzed using a coding strategy aligned with grounded theory methodology. Our findings show that collaboration between R&D and engineering occurs across multiple stages of the product development process and varies according to the characteristics of each ETO archetype. The study identifies the key areas in which both functions contribute to each other’s work and highlights information technology tools and the organizational practices that support effective collaboration. Drawing on relational coordination theory, we classify relational coordination into three types—static, adaptive, and dynamic—corresponding to these archetypes. This study provides one of the first empirical investigations of R&D–engineering collaboration and extends the application of relational coordination theory in ETO firms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多案例研究，探讨了按订单设计（ETO）企业中研发与工程部门之间的协作机制，识别了三种协作类型（静态、自适应、动态），并揭示了不同ETO原型下的协作差异。
AI.research_question: 在按订单设计（ETO）企业中，研发与工程部门如何协作？不同ETO原型下协作模式有何差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管研发与工程在ETO企业中的产品开发活动高度相互依赖，但两者之间的协作关系尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系协调理论（Relational Coordination Theory）
AI.method: 多案例研究设计，涵盖10家企业（代表可重复、基础、复杂三种ETO原型），通过41小时专家访谈和450小时以上直接观察收集数据，采用扎根理论编码策略进行分析。
AI.findings: 研发与工程协作贯穿产品开发多个阶段，且因ETO原型不同而存在差异；识别了双方相互贡献的关键领域，以及支持协作的信息技术工具和组织实践；基于关系协调理论，将协作分为静态、自适应和动态三种类型。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对ETO企业中研发-工程协作进行实证研究，将关系协调理论扩展应用于ETO企业情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ETO企业识别了促进研发与工程协作的关键IT工具和组织实践，帮助企业根据自身ETO原型选择适合的协作模式。

title: Complements or Substitutes? The Interplay between Digitalization and Governance Mechanisms in Enhancing Supply Chain Resilience
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Xi'an University of Technology, MBS School of Business and Independent

detail.title: Complements or Substitutes? The Interplay between Digitalization and Governance Mechanisms in Enhancing Supply Chain Resilience
detail.abstract: Many firms rely on contractual or relational governance mechanisms to mitigate supply chain disruptions and boost resilience. However, these approaches sometimes prove insufficient. To address this dilemma, we explore the combined effects of digitalization and governance mechanisms on supply chain resilience from the fit perspective. Drawing on a sample of 264 Chinese companies, this research analyzes the interplay between theoretical constructs through hierarchical regression. The empirical results show that internal digitalization and contractual governance exhibit a substitutive relationship in enhancing supply chain resilience. Similarly, a substitutive relationship is observed between external digitalization and relational governance. In contrast, a complementary relationship has been identified between internal digitalization and relational governance. We bridge the gap in the existing literature by highlighting the complex and dynamic relationships between digitalization and governance mechanisms in shaping supply chain resilience. We also provide valuable insights for managers seeking to design effective supply chain strategies to navigate disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过264家中国企业的样本数据，探讨了数字化与治理机制（契约治理和关系治理）在提升供应链韧性中的替代与互补关系。结果表明：内部数字化与契约治理呈替代关系，外部数字化与关系治理呈替代关系，而内部数字化与关系治理呈互补关系。
AI.research_question: 数字化与治理机制如何共同（替代或互补）影响供应链韧性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献指出，契约治理和关系治理在缓解供应链中断、提升韧性方面有时效果不足，而数字化为供应链管理提供了新可能，但二者之间的协同效应尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拟合视角（fit perspective）；契约治理理论；关系治理理论；数字化与治理机制的替代/互补理论。
AI.method: 以264家中国企业为样本，采用层次回归分析（hierarchical regression）检验变量间的交互效应。
AI.findings: （1）内部数字化与契约治理在提升供应链韧性上呈替代关系；（2）外部数字化与关系治理呈替代关系；（3）内部数字化与关系治理呈互补关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字化与治理机制在塑造供应链韧性中复杂且动态的关系，弥补了现有文献对二者交互效应缺乏深入研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者设计有效的供应链策略以应对 disruptions 提供了指导：需根据数字化的内外部类型，合理搭配契约或关系治理机制。

title: Optimal Pricing and Shipping Insurance Strategies under a Returnless-Refund Policy: A Game-Theoretic and Empirical Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Huaqiao University and Drexel University

detail.title: Optimal Pricing and Shipping Insurance Strategies under a Returnless-Refund Policy: A Game-Theoretic and Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract: Many Chinese e-commerce platforms, including Pinduoduo and Taobao, have implemented returnless-refund policies in recent years to enhance their after-sales service systems. A "returnless-refund" policy refers to a mechanism where consumers are entitled to a refund for a defective product without returning it. However, this seemingly consumer-friendly policy introduces hidden trade-offs that complicate the joint optimization of pricing and shipping insurance decisions. This paper employs a game-theoretic framework to investigate the optimal pricing and the return shipping insurance strategies of e-retailers under the returnless-refund policy. To ensure the practical relevance of our analytical insights, we further validate the theoretical results using empirical data from a prominent Chinese e-commerce platform. Our analysis reveals that adopting a returnless-refund policy does not always hurt e-retailers’ profits, instead, the impact is determined by product cost and the proportion of returnless-refund transactions. However, the returnless-refund policy consistently suppresses the effectiveness of the shipping insurance strategy for e-retailers. We also demonstrate the impacts of the returnless-refund policy on platforms and consumers in different market scenarios. The findings challenge conventional wisdom by revealing that returnless-refund policies can reshape, rather than simply erode, e-retailers’ profit logic and risk management strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论框架和实证数据，研究了电商平台“仅退款”政策对零售商定价和退货运费险策略的影响。发现该政策并非总是损害利润，而是取决于产品成本和不退货交易比例，但会持续抑制运费险策略的有效性。
AI.research_question: 在“仅退款”政策下，电商零售商如何优化其定价和退货运费险策略？该政策对零售商利润、平台和消费者有何影响？
AI.motivation: 拼多多、淘宝等中国电商平台广泛实施“仅退款”政策，这一看似对消费者有利的政策可能引入隐藏的权衡，使得定价和运费险的联合优化变得复杂，现有研究对此缺乏深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论框架
AI.method: 博弈论建模分析，并结合中国主流电商平台的实证数据进行验证。
AI.findings: （1）“仅退款”政策并非总是损害零售商利润，其影响取决于产品成本和不退货交易的比例；（2）该政策会持续抑制运费险策略对零售商的有效性；（3）“仅退款”政策会重塑而非简单侵蚀零售商的利润逻辑和风险管理策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了“仅退款政策必然损害零售商利润”的传统认知，揭示了该政策如何重塑零售商的利润逻辑和风险管理策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台和零售商在实施“仅退款”政策时如何优化定价和运费险策略提供了理论依据和决策参考。

title: Using AI and Knowledge Graph to Identify Supply-Side Deficiencies in Public EV Charging: Evidence from Wuhan City Message Board
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Wuhan Institute of Technology

detail.title: Using AI and Knowledge Graph to Identify Supply-Side Deficiencies in Public EV Charging: Evidence from Wuhan City Message Board
detail.abstract: Amid the rapid proliferation of new energy vehicles and China's pursuit of carbon neutrality, supply-side deficiencies in public electric vehicle (EV) charging services have become increasingly pronounced, yet existing research has paid insufficient attention to citizens' actual demands and service failure diagnostics. We draw on 7,681 citizen complaint messages from Wuhan's City Message Board and integrate text mining with knowledge graph technologies to extract four key informational dimensions: problem typology, responsibility attribution, spatial distribution, and temporal evolution. A relational network linking these four dimensions is constructed to reveal the structural characteristics and formation mechanisms of supply-side deficiencies. The results show that the reported issues are heavily concentrated in three categories: fire safety hazards, difficulties in EV charger installation, and absence of supporting facilities, which collectively account for 68.86% of total complaints, with negative sentiment exceeding 73% across all categories. Spatially, complaints are concentrated in three districts comprising 45.01% of the citywide total. Property management entities constitute the core accountability node, yet multi-stakeholder coordination mechanisms exhibit significant fragmentation, manifesting as a governance predicament of repeated case transfers and unresolved complaints. Complaint volumes increased continuously from 2017 to 2023 before declining slightly in 2024, with no discernible seasonal patterns. These deficiencies are attributed to a triple failure mechanism encompassing planning failure, market failure, and coordination failure. Based on these findings, a user-centered diagnostic framework is proposed, offering empirical grounding for infrastructure planning and a scalable governance model for addressing supply-side fragmentation in urban service delivery.

AI.tldr: 基于武汉市7,681条市民投诉信息，运用文本挖掘和知识图谱技术，从问题类型、责任归属、空间分布、时间演化四个维度分析公共电动汽车充电服务的供给侧缺陷，发现火灾隐患、充电桩安装困难和配套设施缺失是三大核心问题，物业公司是核心责任节点，并揭示了规划失灵、市场失灵和协调失灵的三重失败机制。
AI.research_question: 公共电动汽车充电服务供给侧缺陷的结构特征和形成机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 新能源汽车快速普及与碳中和政策推进的背景下，公共充电服务供给侧问题日益突出，但现有研究对公民实际需求和服务失败诊断关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共服务供给侧缺陷理论、规划失灵-市场失灵-协调失灵三重失败机制
AI.method: 文本挖掘（7,681条市民投诉文本）+ 知识图谱技术，构建问题类型、责任归属、空间分布、时间演化四维关系网络
AI.findings: (1) 投诉集中在火灾隐患、充电桩安装困难、配套设施缺失三大类（占68.86%），负面情绪超73%；(2) 空间上集中于三个区（占45.01%）；(3) 物业公司为核心责任节点，多主体协调机制碎片化；(4) 投诉量2017-2023年持续增长，2024年略有下降，无明显季节模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"规划失灵-市场失灵-协调失灵"三重失败机制来解释充电服务供给侧缺陷的形成，扩展了公共服务供给侧理论在新能源基础设施领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 构建以用户为中心的诊断框架，为充电基础设施规划提供实证依据，提出解决城市服务供给侧碎片化的可扩展治理模型。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Customer Behavior Analysis: A Systematic Review Towards Intelligent Decision Support Systems
affiliations: Malaysia University of Science and Technology, HUTECH University and Malaysia University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Customer Behavior Analysis: A Systematic Review Towards Intelligent Decision Support Systems
detail.abstract: In the modern business environment, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are widely applied in tasks in customer behavior analysis (CBA), such as purchase intention, churn prediction, customer segmentation and profiling, and customer satisfaction analysis.
